field.name: EVENT_TMR_LD
field.description: Event Timer Load Enable Loads the Event Timer with the values written to the EVENT_TMR[23:0] and EVENT_TMR_FRAC[3:0] fields of this register.

field.name: EVENT_TMR_ADD
field.description: Event Timer Add Enable Increments the Event Timer by the values written to the EVENT_TMR[23:0] and EVENT_TMR_FRAC[3:0] fields of this register.

field.name: EVNTMR_WKUP_TRIG_EN
field.description: Configuration to trigger T[1-4]CMP comparison after a wakeup is detected. This bit is used only for the first TX or RX event after wakeup, and is self-cleared by HW.

field.name: CAPTURE_TIMESTAMP
field.description: SW can write this bit to capture a snapshot of FP4_UNIVERSAL_CLOCK and Event Timer in UC_TIMESTAMP and TIMESTAMP registers. This bit is self-cleared by HW

field.name: TMSTMP_ANCHORED
field.description: When set, CAPTURE_TIMESTAMP will capture an anchored TIMESTAMP of universal clock counter and event timer. This bit does not affect the timestamping at RX SFD detection

field.name: RST_EVNTMR_AT_WKUP
field.description: Bit to enable Event Timer reset at wakeup

field.name: UNIV_CNTR_TIMESTAMP
field.description: Timestamped value captured from FP4_UNIVERSAL_CLOCK counter at CAPTURE_TIMESTAMP assertion from SW. This TIMESTAMP is also updated at SFD detection when Event Timer TIMESTAMP is updated in ZLL TIMESTAMP register

field.name: FP4_UNIVERSAL_CLOCK
field.description: FP4_UNIVERSAL_CLOCK counter (live value) readback from d_ip_15p4_radio_syn block

field.name: EVENT_TMR_PRESET
field.description: for SW to provide the pre-set value to load into, or, add to, the Event Timer when EVENT_TMR_LD or EVENT_TMR_ADD bits in FFU_DSM_CTRL register are set

field.name: PKT_FLTR_IRQ_MASK_A
field.description: PPME_A: if 1'b1: disable PKT_FLTR_IRQ_A to trigger FW IRQ (irq_b, ipi_int_modem_rx)

field.name: PKT_FLTR_IRQ_A
field.description: PPME_A: Pattern match interrupt on PPME_A, generated if a pattern match was found in PPME_A, write 1 to clear

field.name: PKT_FLTR_IRQ_MASK_B
field.description: PPME_B: if 1'b1: disable PKT_FLTR_IRQ_B to trigger FW IRQ (irq_b, ipi_int_modem_rx)

field.name: PKT_FLTR_IRQ_B
field.description: PPME_B: Pattern match interrupt on PPME_B, generated if a pattern match was found in PPME_B, write 1 to clear

field.name: PKT_FLTR_OFST_ERR_A
field.description: PPME_A: Pattern offset error status. Generated at packet start if PKT_FLTR_OFST_A (+ASH index) exceeds the packet length, write 1 to clear

field.name: PKT_FLTR_OFST_ERR_B
field.description: PPME_B: Pattern offset error status. Generated at packet start if PKT_FLTR_OFST_B (+ASH index) exceeds the packet length, write 1 to clear

field.name: PKT_FLTR_PAN_CFG_ERR
field.description: PPME PAN configuration error in concatenation mode Set when the assigned PAN of PPME-A is not equal to the PAN of PPME-B

field.name: IRQSTS_irq
field.description: IRQSTS_IRQ = (SEQIRQ | TXIRQ | RXIRQ | CCAIRQ | RXWTRMKIRQ | FILTERFAIL_IRQ | PLL_INLOCK_IRQ | WAKE_IRQ | ARB_GRANT_DEASSERTION_IRQ | TSM_IRQ | (| TMR_IRQ_STATUS_TMR_IRQ (4:1) )

field.name: PROG_PKT_FLTR_INTR_MSK_STS_IRQ
field.description: PPME IRQ status summary (PKT_FLTR_OFST_ERR_B | PKT_FLTR_OFST_ERR_A | PKT_FLTR_OFST_ERR_B | PKT_FLTR_OFST_ERR_A)

field.name: SAA0_1ST_FREE_IDX_FOUND
field.description: Source Address Absent #0 First Free Index found

field.description: Source Address Absent #1 First Free Index found

field.name: AA_ACQ_1_2_3_THRESH_2M

field.name: OVERH

field.name: OVERH_INV

field.name: SYNCTSCALE

field.name: MAG_WIN

field.name: COND_AA_BUFF_EN

enumeratedValue.name: A0
enumeratedValue.description: disable.

enumeratedValue.name: A1
enumeratedValue.description: enable.

field.name: BYPASS_WITH_RSSI

enumeratedValue.name: A1

enumeratedValue.name: A1

field.name: WIN_FAD_WAIT_SYNCH
field.description: Time-window to wait for clean samples, before transitioning to AA search PHY state, if PD was found after antenna switch , in sample clock cycles(referred to as T3 in the PHY state-machine section).

field.name: WIN_FAD_WAIT_PD
field.description: Time-window to wait for clean samples if PD was not found after antenna switch , in sample clock cycles(referred to as T2 in the PHY state-machine section).

field.name: WIN_FAD_SEARCH_PD
field.description: Time-window to match preamble pattern on samples coming from the previously selected antenna , in sample clock cycles(referred to as T1 in the PHY state-machine section).

field.name: WIN_SEARCH_PD
field.description: Time-window to match preamble pattern on samples coming from the currently selected antenna, in sample clock cycles (referred to as T0 in the PHY state-machine section).

field.name: EXT_TO_MODES_13
field.description: Indicates Timeout extension for modes 1 et 3

field.name: AA_FOUND

field.name: AA_MATCH
field.description: Indicates which non-coded AA has matched. This will clear when the PHY is re-initialized.

field.name: HAMM_DIST
field.description: Indicates the hamming distance witnessed when AA match occurred.

field.name: CORR_MAX
field.description: Indicates the correlation witnessed when AA match occurred

field.name: TOF_OFF
field.description: Timing offset for use in time-of-flight calculation.

field.name: AA_COR_THRESH
field.description: Threshold use to compare the correlation magnitude in the long-range AA correlator.

field.name: AA_HAM_THRESH
field.description: Threshold use to compare the Hamming distance, between reference coded sequence and received coded sequence, in the long-range AA correlator.

field.name: ACCESS_ADDR_HAM
field.description: Threshold use to compare the Hamming distance, between the reference AA sequence and the received Viterbi decoded AA sequence.

field.name: AA_LR_CORR_GAIN
field.description: AA correlator gain. Format ufix6en3. This gain is applied to soft bits from the demodulator before they are used for address search synchronization.

field.name: DECODED_HAMM_DIST
field.description: Hamming distance between the reference sequence and the Viterbi decoded received sequence

field.name: AA_FOUND
field.description: Indicates that a AA detect is active for both LR and uncoded.

field.name: CODED_HAMM_DIST
field.description: Hamming distance between the coded reference sequence and the coded received sequence.

field.name: AA_CORR_MAX
field.description: Indicates the AA correlation magnitude witnessed when AA match occurred

field.name: CMAG_MAX
field.description: Indicates the maximum preamble correlation magnitude during preamble found

enumeratedValue.name: A1
enumeratedValue.description: Use preamble and verify a correlation peak, the synch at the symbol rate as symbol timing is established by the preamble acquisition

enumeratedValue.name: A2
enumeratedValue.description: Use synch only (which may incorporate part of the preamble)

enumeratedValue.name: A3
enumeratedValue.description: Use mainly the sync detection: Use a low threshold on the preamble detector and launch the synch detection only if the preamble has shown a recent peak

field.name: EN_PHY_SM_EXT_RST
field.description: Enable PHY state-machine reset on the external reset port; Reserved, should keep 0.

enumeratedValue.name: A0
enumeratedValue.description: Reset is not allowed.

enumeratedValue.name: A1
enumeratedValue.description: Reset is allowed.

field.name: AGC_FRZ_ON_PD_FOUND_ACQ1_LR
field.description: Specifies AGC freeze condition for non-coded acq.1 and Bluetooth LE long range.

enumeratedValue.name: A1
enumeratedValue.description: AGC freeze on AA found.

enumeratedValue.name: A0
enumeratedValue.description: AGC freeze asserted on PD found.

field.name: PH_BUFF_PTR_SYM
field.description: Phase buffer size to demodulator, long range only.

field.name: EARLY_PD_TIMEOUT
field.description: Time-out used to reset the AGC state-machine for the eventuality that an "PD found early" , expressed in number of sample clock cycles. Event occurs but it is not followed by an "PD found" event

field.name: AA_TIMEOUT_UNCODED
field.description: Time-out value for access address search for uncoded packets, expressed in number of sample clock cycles

field.name: RSSI_CORR_TH
field.description: Threshold use to compare a correlation magnitude value, computed in the acquisition block, in order to determine the correlation flag value provided by the PHY to the LQI computation block. Format is ufix8_En8

field.name: DMA_PAGE_SEL
field.description: Select which DMA page is send out

enumeratedValue.name: A0
enumeratedValue.description: Select DMA PAGE 0 for M3C with cfo;

enumeratedValue.name: A1
enumeratedValue.description: Select DMA PAGE 1 for M3C with magnitude;

enumeratedValue.name: A2
enumeratedValue.description: Select DMA PAGE 2 for un-coded;

enumeratedValue.name: A3
enumeratedValue.description: Select DMA PAGE 3 for Long Range Preamble Detect;

enumeratedValue.name: A4
enumeratedValue.description: Select DMA PAGE 4 for Long Range AA Detect;

field.name: ECO1_RSVD

field.description: Enables various clock gating features. Bits are individually decoded, so any combination is allowable.

field.name: DTEST_MUX_EN
field.description: Reserved . Should be programed as reset value 0.

field.name: DMDAA_HAMM_HP
field.description: Maximum hamming distance from the given AA pattern that may still be accepted as a match in high power case; valid range [0,7].

enumeratedValue.name: A1

enumeratedValue.name: A0
enumeratedValue.description: disable

enumeratedValue.name: A1

field.name: RTT_CFO
field.description: The high accuracy CFO computed by the HARTT block through the CORDIC algorithm.

field.name: RTT_P_DELTA
field.description: Difference between the squared correlation magnitude values, pm-pp provided by the HARTT block, format is sfix10En9.

field.name: RTT_DIST_SAT
field.description: Computed Hamming distance saturated to 2 bits, format is ufix2.

field.name: RTT_INT_ADJ
field.description: An integer adjustment of the timing which takes a value different of 0 when the early-late mechanism in the HARTT block chooses a peak different of the one chosen in the acquisition module (possible values are {-1,0,+1}).

field.name: RTT_FOUND

field.name: HA_RTT_THRESHOLD
field.description: threshold used to validate a HA RTT result.

field.name: FIRST_PDU_BIT

field.name: RTT_SEQ_LEN

field.name: OVERRD_PROGR_AA
field.description: Enables overriding the programmed AA bits with the PN sequence used by RTT;

field.name: EN_HIGH_ACC_RTT
field.description: enables the use of the HA RTT block;

field.name: FM_REF_010

field.name: FM_REF_110
field.description: Contextual values used to derive the FM reference ha_rtt_threshold .

field.name: FM_REF_111
field.description: Contextual values used to derive the FM reference ha_rtt_threshold .

enumeratedValue.name: TSM_SOFT_RESET_1

field.name: data_chan_pkt
field.description: Channel to Distinguish pkt_header Fields, 0x0: advt channel, 0x1: data channel

field.name: rx_data_rate
field.description: LE Rx Packet Data Rate, 0x0: Rx packet data rate 1 Mbps, 0x1: Rx packet data rate 2 Mbps

field.name: tx_data_rate
field.description: LE Tx Packet Data Rate, 0x0: Tx packet data rate 1 Mbps, 0x1: Tx packet data rate 2 Mbps

field.name: data_length_ext
field.description: LE Data Length Extension. Should be 0 when iso_pdu_sel is 1, 0x0: disable; support up to 31 bytes of payload for data channel PDU, 0x1: enable; support up to 255 bytes; or 251 bytes for encryption packet; of payload, for data channel PDU

field.name: advt_length_ext
field.description: LE Advertising Length Extension. Should be 0 when iso_pdu_sel is 1, 0x0: disable; support up to 37 bytes of payload for advertising channel PDU, 0x1: enable; support up to 255 bytes of payload for advertising channel PDU

field.name: iso_pdu_sel
field.description: Select ISO PDU type, 0x0: data_chan_pkt=0 selects Data PDU. data_chan_pkt=1 selects Adv PDU, 0x1: data_chan_pkt=0 selects BIS PDU. data_chan_pkt=1 selects CIS PDU

field.name: direct_test_mode
field.description: BLE direct test mode, 0x0: BLE in normal mode, 0x1: BLE in direct test mode (bypass Rx packet length < 6 check in adv mode)

field.name: channel_index
field.description: Channel Index Value for Whitening Initialization

field.name: tx_extn_en
field.description: Tx Extension Packet, Tx Extension Packet, 0x0: transmit data extension; regular; non-location BLE transmit packet, 0x1: transmit data extension; transmit extension field for current packet

field.name: rx_length_max
field.description: Maximum Length for rx_length_err, - For Advt Channel: 37 (if advt_length_ext = 0) or 255 (if advt_length_ext = 1)., - For Data Channel: 31 (if data_length_ext = 0 and ccm_en_rx = 0) or, 27 (if data_length_ext = 0 and ccm_en_rx = 1) or, 255 (if data_length_ext = 1 and ccm_en_rx = 0) or, 251 (if data_length_ext = 1 and ccm_en_rx = 1).

field.name: tx_extn_length
field.description: Tx Extension Length for Tx DFE Packet, Length of extension field to be transmitted. This value is in the unit of 8 usec time frame and includes the guard period (for example; spec defined 1~4 usec) between CRC and the antenna switching part of extension., This bit is valid only when tx_extn_en is set.

field.name: rx_rf_agc_index
field.description: BRF Rx Power Control Index, BRF Rx power control setting that is programmed into the BRF_RX_PKT_STATUS[7:5] register., These index bits are taken effect only when RIF register BTU_RIF_CTL0[1] is set.

register.name: ble_reg_tx_acc_addr
register.description: Tx Access Address; for Advt and Data Packets

register.name: ble_reg_rx_pkt_status
register.description: Rx Packet Status; for Advt and Data Packets

field.name: rx_extn_suppl_info
field.description: Rx Packet Supplemental Info Byte if available

field.name: simul_scan_coded_en
field.description: Detected Rx Coded Packet Correlation Hit in Simultaneous Scan Mode, 0x0: Detected BLE 1M Packet Correlation Hit or no correlation at all in Simultaneous, Scan Mode, 0x1: Detected Rx Coded Packet Correlation Hit in Simultaneous Scan Mode

field.name: rx_preamble_match_sts
field.description: Detected Rx Preamble Match during BLE Long Range RX, 0x0: Preamble has not been detected on most recent RX in long range mode., 0x1: Preamble has been detected on most recent RX in long range mode. This indication, resets at the start of next RX

field.name: ble_rx_coded_pkt_indic_sts
field.description: Coding Indicator (CI) value received during BLE Long Range RX. This field indicates the, coding rate of the FEC Block 2 of the LR Rx packet and is valid from rx_hdr_done_intr till start of next Rx packet, 0x0: FEC Block 2 coded using S=8., 0x1: FEC Block 2 coded using S=2.

field.name: adv_addr_not_present
field.description: This bit indicates if advertiser address is present or absent for each advertising packet received, 0x0: Advertiser address is present in extended advertising packet received; or, received packet is a legacy advertising packet, 0x1: Advertiser address is not present in extended advertising packet received

field.name: rx_cntrl_length_max
field.description: Maximum Control PDU Length for rx_length_err, This is the length of max length Control PDUs., This field is used only if rx_cntrl_length_max_sel is set to 1.

field.name: rx_cntrl_length_max_sel
field.description: Select Length Check Register for Control PDUs, 0x0: select rx_length_max for control PDU length check, 0x1: select rx_cntrl_length_max for control PDU length check

field.name: reuse_rx_adv_addr_done_intr
field.description: Allow reuse of rx_adv_addr_done_intr for indicating the absence of advertiser address in the received advertising channel PDU, 0x0: rx_adv_addr_done_intr = 1 for legacy and extended advertising channel packets, received with advertiser address rx_adv_addr_done_intr = 0 for extended, advertising channel packets received without advertiser address, 0x1: rx_adv_addr_done_intr = 1 for legacy and extended advertising channel packets, with advertiser address and extended advertising channel , packets received without advertiser address (in conjunction with, adv_addr_not_present)

field.name: auth_disable_tx
field.description: When ccm_en_tx = 1; setting 1 for CCM Enable for Tx Packet with encryption only and no authentication.

field.name: auth_disable_rx
field.description: When ccm_en_rx = 1; setting 1 for CCM Enable for Rx Packet with encryption only and no authentication.

field.name: inc_tx_pkt_cnt
field.description: Increment Tx CCM Packet Count, For each new Tx packet; writing 1 will increment the value in BLE_REG_TX_CCM_PKT_CNT_0/1 registers by 1. This bit is self-cleared by hardware.

field.name: inc_rx_pkt_cnt
field.description: Increment Rx CCM Packet Count, For each new Rx packet; writing 1 will increment the value in BLE_REG_RX_CCM_PKT_CNT_0/1 registers by 1. This bit is self-cleared by hardware.

field.name: corhit_timestamp_qus
field.description: QUS level timestamp, This QUS timestamp is updated at correlation hit interrupt.

field.name: corhit_timestamp_clock
field.description: Native clock value timestamp, Lower 28 bits are same as BTC native clock. Upper 4 bits are carry from BTC native clock wraps. This timestamp is updated at correlation hit interrupt.

field.name: pktend_timestamp_qus
field.description: QUS level timestamp, This QUS timestamp is updated at tx or rx packet ends including normal tx/rx packet ends; hw/sw aborts and rx corrlation timeout.

field.name: pktend_timestamp_clock
field.description: Native clock value timestamp, Lower 28 bits are same as BTC native clock. Upper 4 bits are carry from BTC native clock wraps. This timestamp is updated at tx or rx packet ends including normal tx/rx packet ends; hw/sw aborts and rx corrlation timeout.

field.name: err_inj_en
field.description: Software error injection enable, 0x0: disable error injection, 0x1: enable error injection

field.name: err_inj_dir
field.description: software error injection direction, 0x0: error injection on Tx side, 0x1: error injection on Rx side

field.name: err_inj_timer
field.description: software error injection timer, Packet bit position (1;2;..N) to start error injection if err_inj_en is set. Tx bit error can be injected from preamble to crc; so position 1 is first preamble bit. Rx bit error can be injected from header to crc; so position 1 is first header bit.

field.name: tx_dmem_crc_cor
field.description: hardware Tx DMEM underflow CRC corruption enable, Enable CRC corruption at first 16-bit of Tx CRC if Tx DMEM underflow error interrupt is detected. Only valid when software controlled err_inj_en is zero. All the CRC bits transmitted will be inverted to cause CRC failure on the receiving device., 0x0: disable, 0x1: enable

field.name: tx_aes_crc_cor
field.description: hardware Tx AES underflow CRC corruption enable, Enable CRC corruption at first 16-bit of Tx CRC if Tx AES underflow error interrupt is detected. Only valid when software controlled err_inj_en is zero. All the CRC bits transmitted will be inverted to cause CRC failure on the receiving device., 0x0: disable, 0x1: enable

field.name: tx_dma_crc_cor
field.description: hardware Tx DMA CRC corruption enable, Enable CRC corruption at first 16-bit of Tx CRC if Tx DMA error interrupt is detected. Only valid when software controlled err_inj_en is zero. All the CRC bits transmitted will be inverted to cause CRC failure on the receiving device., 0x0: disable, 0x1: enable

field.name: err_inj_pattern
field.description: 16-Bit Error injection pattern, 0x0: do not flip the bit, 0x1: flip the bit

field.name: rx_dmem_crc_cor
field.description: hardware Rx DMEM underflow CRC corruption enable, Set this enable to enable CRC corruption if Rx DMEM underflow error interrupt is detected. Only valid when software controlled err_inj_en is zero. The crc_success bit is flipped at the end of Rx., 0x0: disable, 0x1: enable

field.name: rx_aes_crc_cor
field.description: hardware Rx AES underflow CRC corruption enable, Set this enable to enable CRC corruption if Rx AES underflow error interrupt is detected. Only valid when software controlled err_inj_en is zero. The crc_success bit is flipped at the end of Rx, 0x0: disable, 0x1: enable

field.name: rx_dma_crc_cor
field.description: hardware Rx DMA CRC corruption enable, Set this enable to enable CRC corruption if Rx DMA error interrupt is detected. Only valid when software controlled err_inj_en is zero. The crc_success bit is flipped at the end of Rx., 0x0: disable, 0x1: enable

field.name: coex_lock_delay
field.description: Register Loader ALternate Start Address, Programmable delay in quarter microseconds after btu_bt_req assertion to MRC when Coex lock fail condition is checked in BTU. MRC samples TX power and TX/RX frequency value from BTU after sampling all bt_state serial information. This delay is used to give more time for first 8 bytes of RL.

field.name: rl_start_address_alt
field.description: Register Loader ALternate Start Address, This points to the alternate start address of memory structure that ble_reg_ldr should fetch from. This pointer is the only used when RL_alt is 1. In alternating mode; every alternate Register Loading is done from this pointer. Only Bits 15:0 are used from this register. The upper 16-bits are reused from BLE_REG_RL_START_ADDR

field.name: rl_start_address
field.description: Register Loader Start Address, This points to the start address of memory structure that ble_reg_ldr should fetch from.

field.name: load_ccm
field.description: Load CCM related memory content, For each new Connection Event; writing 1 will trigger BLE register loader to load only CCM related memory contents (memory offset = 0x20~44) to their BLE registers. This bit should be set along with load_non_ccm bit for packet events; to enable correct DBUS programming.This bit is self-cleared by hardware.

field.name: load_non_ccm
field.description: Load non-CCM related memory content, For each new Connection Event; writing 1 will trigger BLE register loader to load non-CCM related memory contents (memory offset = 0x00~1C) to their BLE registers. This bit is self-cleared by hardware.

field.name: auto_load_ccm
field.description: Auto Load CCM related memory content, For each new Connection Event; writing 1 will trigger BLE register loader to load only CCM related memory contents (memory offset = 0x20~44) to their BLE registers at every start_rif_tx/start_rif_rx. This bit should be set along with auto_load_non_ccm bit for packet events; to enable correct DBUS programming. This bit is self-cleared by hardware.

field.name: auto_load_non_ccm
field.description: Auto Load non-CCM related memory content, For each new Connection Event; writing 1 will trigger BLE register loader to load non-CCM related memory contents (memory offset = 0x00~1C) to their BLE registers. This bit is self-cleared by hardware.

field.name: rl_lock
field.description: BLE Register Loader Lock bit, For each new Connection Event; rl_lock serves as Register Loader lock bit. It should be set along with load_ccm or load_non_ccm bit or before start_rif_tx/rx time if using auto_load_ccm or auto_load_non_ccm bits. It must remain set for the duration of packets that the Register Loader values are in effect. At the end of last packet; the rl_lock bit should be cleared by firmware. This bit is used to generate rx_lock_fail_intr or tx_lock_fail_intr.

field.name: rl_alt
field.description: BLE Register Loader Alternate Mode Enable, Indicates which RL_START_ADDR is to be used., 0x0: Always use RL_START_ADDR., 0x1: Use Toggle mode where RL_START_ADDR and RL_START_ADDR_ALT are used for, alternating register loading.

field.name: rl_alt_reset
field.description: BLE Register Loader Alternate Mode Reset, One-shot reset command to HW to use RL_START_ADDR pointer for the next register loading; regardless of which pointer was used in previous register loading. Self cleared by HW.

field.name: coex_lock_bypass
field.description: BLE Register Loader Coex Lock Bypass bit, Config bit to bypass coex lock fail detection on Register loader. Coex lock fail check can be bypassed by setting this bit to 1. This setting can be used if FW can pre-program the TX power and TX/RX frequency values in advance of a connection event without using register loader.

field.name: rl_ccm_done
field.description: Done loading CCM memory, Register Loader has done loading CCM related memory content into their BLE registers., 0x0: Not done., 0x1: Done loading.

field.name: rl_non_ccm_done
field.description: Done loading non-CCM memory, Register Loader has done loading non-CCM related memory content into their BLE registers., 0x0: Not done., 0x1: Done loading.

field.name: rl_busy
field.description: Register Loader busy, Status indicating BLE Register Loader is busy. Asserted when fetching memory starts and de-asserted right after done writing to BLE registers., 0x0: Register Loader is idle., 0x1: Register Loader is busy.

field.name: rl_dma_err
field.description: Register Loader Has DMA Error, Register Loader experienced DMA error., 0x0: No error, 0x1: SoC DMA slave has replied with ERROR response during Register Loader read, transfers.

field.name: rl_coex_done
field.description: Coex Register Loading Done, Indicating Coex related register loading is done; i.e. the first 8 bytes of register loader., 0x0: Not done., 0x1: Done.

field.name: rl_dbus_done
field.description: DBUS Register Loading Done, Indicating DBUS WDATA loading is done for the first 12 bytes of register loader., 0x0: Not done., 0x1: Done.

field.name: rl_at_curr
field.description: Register Loader Alternate Pointer, Indicates which RL pointer is currently in use. When RL_alt = 0; this bit is always 0. when RL_alt = 1; this bit toggles for every register loading to indicate the Register Loader in use.

register.name: ble_reg_dfe_pkt_extension_cntrl
register.description: Tx/Rx Packet Extension Control, Control register to Data Field Extension after CRC for BLE location packet.

field.name: tx_extn_pattern
field.description: Tx Packet Extension Pattern, The value programmed in this bit reflects what will be sent out during the extension part of the Tx location packet. This value is also sent during the guard time at the beginning of the extension field., This bit is valid ONLY when tx_extn_en is set., 0x0: send 0000..., 0x1: send 1111...

field.name: delay_extn_end
field.description: Extension Packet Delay CDT, Define whether to delay CDT timer to start at packet estimated end time if extension field is corrupted due to antSwitchStatus (for example; BCA antenna is not honored) de-assertion; or due to BCA grant loss., If it is set; CDT timer needs to be delayed to the estimated end of extension filed time to line up the TIFS for next packet., If it is not set; for the same conditions; do not perform any CDT manipulation in hardware. This setting might cause BLE not to be able to Tx or Rx following the packet extension corruption., 0x0: do not perform any CDT manipulation in hardware, 0x1: delay CDT timer to the estimated end of extension

field.name: rx_iq_sample_rate
field.description: Rx IQ Sampling Rate, Define reception rate for IQ samples in extension field., 0x0: receive IQ sample every 4 usec, 0x1: receive IQ sample every 2 usec, 0x2: receive IQ sample every 1 usec, 0x3: not valid

field.name: extn_guard_time
field.description: Extension Packet Guard Time, Define the guard interval between the CRC and extension supplementals in the unit of usec., 0x0: guard interval is 1 usec, 0x1: guard interval is 2 usec, 0x2: guard interval is 3 usec, 0x3: guard interval is 4 usec

field.name: extn_ref_ant_time
field.description: Extension Reference Antenna IQ Sample Time, Define the reference antenna interval after the extension guard time and before switching antenna in the unit of usec. During this interval; IQ samples received is considered in the same of which the reference antenna is used., 0x0: reference antenna interval is 0 usec, 0x1: reference antenna interval is 2 usec, 0x2: reference antenna interval is 4 usec, 0x3: reference antenna interval is 8 usec

field.name: rx_extn_en
field.description: Rx Packet Extension Enable, Enable bit of Rx extension packet., 0x0: disable to receive data extension, 0x1: enable to receive data extension

field.name: rx_iq_sample_rate_rcv_override
field.description: Rx Packet Extension IQ Sample Rate Override, When this is set and received packet is an AoD packet with extension field; IQ sample rate is derived from received supplemental type field of supplemental info byte; which is considered to override the software preset sample rate.

field.name: rx_extn_sw_override_en
field.description: Rx Extension Packet Software Override, Software enable bit to override rx_extn_rcv and rx_extn_length from Rx PDU header., 0x0: disable software override, 0x1: enable software override

field.name: rx_extn_sw_override_rcv
field.description: Extension Packet Received Software Override, The value of rx_extn_rcv to which software overrides., This bit is used ONLY when rx_extn_sw_override_en bit is set.

field.name: rx_extn_sw_override_suppl_info
field.description: Rx Extension Supplemental Info Byte Software Override, The value of rx_extn_length as of rx_extn_suppl_info[4:0] to which software overrides., The value of rx_extn_suppl_type as of rx_extn_suppl_info[7:6] to which software overrides., This length is used ONLY when rx_extn_sw_override_en bit is set.

register.name: ble_reg_rx_adv_pdu_type
register.description: Rx Advertising Packet PDU Type, Control register of Bluetooth extended advertising packet PDU type.

field.name: rx_extn_adv_pdu_type_0
field.description: Extended advertising PDU type, Extended advertising PDU type defined has an advertising extension header and advData fields.

field.name: rx_extn_adv_pdu_type_0_en
field.description: Extended advertising PDU type enable, Use the defined extended advertising PDU type for Rx matching., 0x0: disable the defined PDU type for matching ext advertising, 0x1: enable the defined PDU type for matching ext advertising

field.name: rx_extn_adv_pdu_type_1
field.description: Extended advertising PDU type, Extended advertising PDU type defined has an advertising extension header and advData fields.

field.name: rx_extn_adv_pdu_type_1_en
field.description: Extended advertising PDU type enable, Use the defined extended advertising PDU type for Rx matching., 0x0: disable the defined PDU type for matching ext advertising, 0x1: enable the defined PDU type for matching ext advertising

field.name: rx_extn_adv_pdu_type_2
field.description: Extended advertising PDU type, Extended advertising PDU type defined has an advertising extension header and advData fields.

field.name: rx_extn_adv_pdu_type_2_en
field.description: Extended advertising PDU type enable, Use the defined extended advertising PDU type for Rx matching., 0x0: disable the defined PDU type for matching ext advertising, 0x1: enable the defined PDU type for matching ext advertising

field.name: rx_adv_type_chk_val
field.description: Received advertising PDU type check value, Regular advertising PDU type value to be checked for Rx matching. Rx packet's PDU type <= rx_adv_type_chk_val is considered as valid regular advertising PDU.

field.name: tx_coded_pkt_en
field.description: Tx Coded Packet Enable, Tx Coded Packet Enable, 0x0: regular; use non-coded PHY to transmit packet, 0x1: use LE coded PHY to transmit packet

field.name: tx_coded_pkt_indic
field.description: Tx Coded Packet Indicator, When tx_coded_pkt_en is set; indicate LE coding scheme PHY uses to transmit packet. C=2; if 2'b01; C=8; if 2'b00.

field.name: rx_coded_pkt_en
field.description: Rx Coded Packet Enable, Rx Coded Packet Enable, 0x0: regular; use non-coded PHY to receive packet, 0x1: use LE coded PHY to receive packet

field.name: simul_scan_en
field.description: Simultaneous Scan Enable, Enable simultaneous scan mode to receive BLE 1M and coded PHY ADV packets; whichever has correlation hit first., 0x0: disable, 0x1: enable. When enabled; rx_coded_pkt_en bit must set to 0.

field.name: simul_scan_1m
field.description: Simultaneous Scan Results in 1M Mode; if Concurrent Correlation Hit., When simul_scan_en is 1; if both 1M and coded PHY correlators have correlation hit at the same time; this bit decides which mode to continue Rx. This bit has no effect if only 1 of the correlator has correlation hit., 0x0: Continue Rx in coded PHY packet mode - preferred as it takes longer time to, correlate the access address., 0x1: Continue Rx in BLE 1M mode.

field.name: irk_base_addr
field.description: IRK Base Address, Programmable start of IRK storage address in EBRAM. EBRAM is shared with BrEdr logic. Therefore this start address is programmable; so that different platforms may be able to use different EBRAM configurations.

field.name: sw_irk_hash
field.description: Software provided hash for IRK resolution, To perform a software driven IRK resolution; software writes the lower 24 bits of RPA address into this register. This value is called hash and is compared with hardware calculated hash to conclude on whether the key can be used to resolve addresses.

field.name: sw_irk_prand
field.description: Software provided prand for IRK resolution, To perform a software driven IRK resolution; software writes part of upper 24 bits of RPA address into this register. This value is called prand[7:0] and is used to generate local hash.

field.name: sw_irk_prand
field.description: Software provided hash for IRK resolution, To perform a software driven IRK resolution; software writes part of upper 24 bits of RPA address into this register. This value is called prand[23:8] and is used to generate local hash.

field.name: irk_resolution_en
field.description: IRK resolution enable, When this bit is set; hardware will parse incoming advt channel packets to attempt IRK resolution on resolvable private addresses. This bit does not affect software override/access to IRK locations in hardware EBRAM area. So; disabling this bit can be used as a backup to stop hardware driven IRK resolving; and use software provided values after packet has been fully received.

field.name: irk_sw_lock
field.description: Lock bits for Software IRK queue access, This bit allows software and hardware to access the EBRAM IRK queue locations safely., 0x0: IRK queue is not in use by software, 0x1: IRK queue is in use by software

field.name: sw_irk_resolve_cmd
field.description: Software IRK resolve command, This self clearing bit triggers a software requested IRK resolution process. The prand and hash values are provided in sw_irk_hash and sw_irk_prand fields. The software lock bit irk_sw_lock; should be set to 1 before the command is set. Self cleared by hardware

field.name: kill_irk_resolve
field.description: Kill IRK resolve process, This bit will kill IRK resolve process and put the state machine back to idle. Software is responsible to clear this bit., 0x0: IRK resolve is not killed, 0x1: IRK resolve is killed by software

field.name: irk_queue_length
field.description: Length of IRK queue in EBRAM, Specifies valid IRK queue length. All values between 0 to 255 are valid. If IRK queue is empty; this value should be set to 0.

field.name: irk_resolved_id_addr
field.description: ID address for successful IRK resolution, If IRK resolution was successful; this register holds the lower 32 bits of the 48-bit ID address of the device.

field.name: irk_resolved_id_addr
field.description: ID address for successful IRK resolution, If IRK resolution was successful; this register holds the upper bits (47:32) of the 48 bit ID address of the device.

field.name: irk_resolved_id_addr_type
field.description: ID address type for successful IRK resolution, If IRK resolution was successful; this register holds the Device Type information of the device.

field.name: irk_resolution_result
field.description: Result of latest IRK resolution, The values indicate if IRK resolution is finished or ongoing; successful or unsuccessful., 0x0: resolution in progress, 0x1: entry was found in IRK queue, 0x2: entry was not found in IRK queue, 0x3: IRK queue search not done for this packet

field.name: irk_hw_lock
field.description: Lock bits for Hardware IRK EBRAM access, This bit allows software and hardware to access the IRK queue locations safely., 0x0: IRK queue is not in use by hardware, 0x1: IRK queue is in use by hardware

field.name: irk_fsm_state
field.description: IRK resolve state machine status, This is the current vlaue of the IRK resolve state machine (for example irk_fsm_state).

field.name: irk_resolve_position
field.description: Position of last IRK queue lookup in EBRAM, This is the last offset that was searched. For successful resolutions; it is the offset where device IRK was found. For unsuccessful resolutions; this is the last offset in queue.

field.name: whitelist_base_addr
field.description: WHITELIST BASE ADDR, Programmable start of Whitelist storage address in EBRAM. EBRAM is shared with BrEdr logic. Therefore this start address is programmable; so that different platforms may be able to use different EBRAM configurations.

field.name: sw_wl_device_addr_0
field.description: Software provided device address for whitelist search, To perform a software whitelist query; software writes the lower 32 bits of device address into this register. This value is used together with some fields in next register BLE_REG_WHITELIST_CTRL_1.

field.name: sw_wl_device_addr_1
field.description: Software provided Device address for whitelist search, To perform a software whitelist query; software writes the upper 16 bits of device address into this register. Together with BLE_REG_WHITELIST_CTRL_0; this represents the 48-bit device address for software white list lookup.

field.name: sw_wl_device_type
field.description: Software provided Device address type for whitelist search, This bit specifies the device address type to be used for software whitelist query., 0x0: public address, 0x1: random address

field.name: sw_wl_query_cmd
field.description: Software whitelist query command, This self clearing bit triggers a software requested whitelist search for the device specified by sw_wl_device_type; sw_wl_device_addr_1 and sw_wl_device_addr_0 fields. The lock bit wl_sw_lock; should be set to 1 before the command is set. Self cleared by hardware.

field.name: wl_sw_lock
field.description: Lock bits for software whitelist access, This bit should be set by software when it is modifying the EBRAM whitelist area, 0x0: whitelist is not in use by software, 0x1: whitelist is in use by software

field.name: hw_wl_search_en
field.description: Inline White list search enable, When this bit is set; hardware will parse incoming advt channel packets to attempt white list filtering inline. This bit does not affect software override/access to the whitelist operations in hardware EBRAM area. So; disabling this bit can be used as a backup to stop hardware driven whitelist searching; and use software provided values after packet has been fully received.

field.name: kill_wl_search
field.description: Kill whitelist search, This bit will kill whitelist search process and put the state machine back to idle. Software is responsible to clear this bit., 0x0: whitelist search is not killed, 0x1: whitelist search is killed by software

field.name: whitelist_length
field.description: Length of whitelist in EBRAM, Specifies valid whitelist length. All values between 0 to 255 are valid. If whitelist is empty; this value should be set to 0.

field.name: hw_wl_lookup_result
field.description: Result of latest hardware white list lookup, The values indicate if query is finished or ongoing; successful or unsuccessful., 0x0: lookup in progress, 0x1: entry was found in whitelist, 0x2: entry was not found in whitelist, 0x3: whitelist search not done for this packet

field.name: wl_hw_lock
field.description: Lock bits for Hardware whitelist access, This bit allows software and hardware to access the EBRAM whitelist locations safely., 0x0: whitelist is not in use by hardware, 0x1: whitelist is in use by hardware

field.name: wl_fsm_state
field.description: Whitelist search state machine status, This is the whitelist state machine; e.g. wl_fsm_state; current value

field.name: hw_wl_lookup_position
field.description: Position of last hardware whitelist lookup in EBRAM, For successful lookups; it is the offset where specified address is located in the whitelist. For unsuccessful lookups; this is the offset to be asserted. For example; if specified address is between offset 3 and 4; it reports 4 which is the offset software will insert for the specified address. If whitelist_length = 10; the entry position is 0 to 9; and if the specified address is bigger than the offset 9th entry; it will report 10. For the extreme case (whitelist_length = 255; and the specified address is bigger than the offset 254th entry); it reports 255.

field.name: sw_wl_lookup_result
field.description: Result of latest software white list lookup, The values indicate if query is finished or ongoing; successful or unsuccessful., 0x0: lookup in progress, 0x1: entry was found in whitelist, 0x2: entry was not found in whitelist, 0x3: whitelist search not done for this software command

field.name: sw_wl_lookup_position
field.description: Position of last software whitelist lookup in EBRAM, For successful lookups; it is the offset where specified address is located in the whitelist. For unsuccessful lookups; this is the offset to be asserted. For example; if specified address is between offset 3 and 4; it reports 4 which is the offset software will insert for the specified address. If whitelist_length = 10; the entry position is 0 to 9; and if the specified address is bigger than the offset 9th entry; it will report 10. For the extreme case (whitelist_length = 255; and the specified address is bigger than the offset 254th entry); it reports 255.

field.name: td_start_address
field.description: Tx Descriptor Start Address, The currently active TD (Tx Descriptor) is pointed by td_start_address.

field.name: td_busy
field.description: TD busy, Status indicating the active TD is busy and being used by hardware. Asserted when fetching TD starts and de-asserted right after TD status writes back., 0x0: TD is idle, 0x1: TD is busy and being used by hardware

field.name: tx_extn_ant_switch_fail
field.description: Tx antenna switch status on packet extension, Status indicating the Tx antenna switch for the current transmitted extension has failed., 0x0: Tx antenna switch pattern is honored; antSwitchStatus was never de-asserted, during packet extension, 0x1: Tx antenna switch pattern is not honored

field.name: tx_extn_abort
field.description: Tx extension packet hardware abort status, Status indicating the Tx extension packet is aborted by hardware., 0x0: No abort condition happened during Tx extension, 0x1: hardware abort condition was detected during Tx extension

field.name: tx_has_err
field.description: Tx Has Error, Tx packet of using this TD experienced at least 1 of the following errors., 0x0: No error, 0x1: At least 1 of rif_abort_tx; tx_dmem_underflow_intr; tx_aes_underflow_intr and, tx_lock_fail_intr has been asserted during packet transmission

field.name: tx_dma_err
field.description: Tx Has DMA Error, Tx packet of using this TD experienced DMA error., 0x0: No error, 0x1: SoC DMA slave has replied with ERROR response during packet transmission

field.name: tx_rl_lockfail_sts
field.description: Tx Has RL lock fail, Status indicating Tx packet has lock fail because of register loader, 0x0: No error, 0x1: Tx_lock_fail_intr has been asserted during packet transmission

field.name: rd_start_address
field.description: Rx Descriptor Start Address, The currently active RD (Rx Descriptor) is pointed by rd_start_address.

field.name: rd_busy
field.description: RD busy, Status indicating the active RD is busy and being used by hardware. Asserted when fetching RD starts and de-asserted right after RD status writes back., 0x0: RD is idle, 0x1: RD is busy and being used by hardware

field.name: rx_extn_rcv
field.description: Extension Packet Received, This bit is valid ONLY on received packets when CRC has passed., 0x0: regular Rx packet was received, 0x1: extension field packet was received

field.name: rx_extn_ant_switch_fail
field.description: Rx antenna switch status on packet extension, Status indicating the Rx antenna switch for the current receiving extension has failed., 0x0: Rx antenna switch pattern is honored; antSwitchStatus was never de-asserted, during packet extension, 0x1: Rx antenna switch pattern is not honored

field.name: rx_extn_abort
field.description: Rx extension packet hardware abort status, Status indicating the Rx extension packet is aborted by hardware., 0x0: no abort condition happened during Rx extension, 0x1: hardware abort condition was detected during Rx extension

field.name: rx_has_err
field.description: Rx Has Error, Rx packet of using this RD experienced at least 1 of the following errors., 0x0: No error, 0x1: At least 1 of rif_abort_rx; rx_dmem_overflow_intr; rx_aes_underflow_intr and, rx_lock_fail_intr has been asserted during packet reception

field.name: rx_dma_err
field.description: Rx Has DMA Error, Rx packet of using this RD experienced DMA error., 0x0: No error, 0x1: SoC DMA slave has replied with ERROR response during packet reception

field.name: rx_rl_lockfail_sts
field.description: Rx Has RL lock fail, Status indicating Rx packet has lock fail because of register loader, 0x0: No error, 0x1: Rx_lock_fail_intr has been asserted during packet transmission

field.name: rd_alt_curr
field.description: Current RD in use, This bit indicates which RD pointer is currently in use. When rd_alt is 0 this bit is always 0; when rd_alt = 1 this bit toggles for every RX to indicate the RD in use., 0x0: Normal RD is being used, 0x1: Alternate RD is being used

field.name: rx_extn_length
field.description: Rx Extension Length, Length of valid I/Q samples received. The value is in the unit of 8 usec time frame. BLE still sends this I/Q samples to memory for firmware and indicates the valid number of samples in this field even though Rx was aborted during the extension reception., This bit is valid ONLY when rx_extn_rcv bit is set.

field.name: ble_arb_rssi_val
field.description: Software programable RSSI value for RSSI based arbitration

field.name: rd_start_address_alt
field.description: Alternate Rx Descriptor Start Address, The Alternate RD (Rx Descriptor) is pointed by rd_start_address_alt.

field.name: rd_alt
field.description: Toggle mode for RD_START_ADDRESS, This bit indicates which RD_START_ADDRESS is to be used, 0x0: always use rd_start_address, 0x1: use Toggle mode where rd_start_address and rd_start_address_alt are used for, alternating RX

field.name: rd_alt_reset
field.description: Reset bit, This bit is used to reset the alternating mode, 0x0: No reset, 0x1: reset; use the RD_START_ADDRESS for the next pkt irrespective of what was used, for the previous pkt

field.name: sleep_ok_timer
field.description: sys_clk_sync_sleep_ok will deassert at timer expiration

field.name: aslv_lat_opt_en
field.description: ahb access 4mclk domain register adaptive mechanism control bit, This bit enables or disables the adaptive mechanism inside the BLE AHB slave that is intended to improve latencies towards 4MHz domain registers. To restart the mechanism; after changing the SYS clock frequency; program it to 0 and back to 1. No r/w delays are needed. It is not necessary to restart the mechanism when switching to higher SYS clock frequency., 0x0: Disable the adaptive mechanism., 0x1: Enable the adaptive mechanism by default

field.name: sw_ccm_clk_req
field.description: CCM/AES clock control, 0x0: disable clock for encryption, 0x1: request (enable) clock for encryption

field.name: secure_irk_decrypt_dyn
field.description: Decrypt IRK using DKey (active high pulse), When this bit is set; BTU will descramble the IRKs using DKEY from local store. The scrambled Keys should be written in BLE_REG_AES_DIN\* registeres and the plain text IRKs will be saved in BLE_REG_AES_DOUT register. The BLE_REG_AES_KEY\* register are not used in this mode., This bit is self clearing and is cleared by HW when AES operation is done., Note: Since BTU's AES engine only supports encryption mode (as purposely chosen for CCM mode); it is agreed with MICRO team that technically the Sentinel will perform the AES decryption operation to generate the ESK while BTU will carry out the AES encryption operation to derive the plain text SK. So; at BTU side we do such: SK = AES-128 Encryp (ESK; DKey_SK) IRK = AES-128 Encryp(EIRK; DKey_IRK) At S200 side; they do such: ESK = AES-128 Decryp(SK; DKey_SK) EIRK = AES-128 Decryp(IRK; DKey_IRK) So; the functional process on BTU side is to decrypt to unwrap the SK or IRK; but the actual HW operation is encryption.

field.name: lock_sw_aes_regs
field.description: Lock Software AES registers from write, 0x0: All 12 Software AES registers (BLE_REG_AES_KEY_0~3; BLE_REG_AES_DIN_0~3;, BLE_REG_AES_DOUT_0~3) can be written as normal., 0x1: All 12 Software AES registers are read-only. Software and hardware write to them, is disabled.

register.name: ble_reg_aes_din_0
register.description: Raw Data Input 0 for Software AES encryption

field.name: sw_aes_din
field.description: Raw Data Input for AES Encryption ([31:0] of 128-bit)

register.name: ble_reg_aes_din_1
register.description: Raw Data Input 1 for Software AES encryption

field.name: sw_aes_din
field.description: Raw Data Input for AES Encryption ([63:32] of 128-bit)

register.name: ble_reg_aes_din_2
register.description: Raw Data Input 2 for Software AES encryption

field.name: sw_aes_din
field.description: Raw Data Input for AES Encryption ([95:64] of 128-bit)

register.name: ble_reg_aes_din_3
register.description: Raw Data Input 3 for Software AES encryption

field.name: sw_aes_din
field.description: Raw Data Input for AES Encryption ([127:96] of 128-bit)

field.name: rt_err_intr
field.description: rt_err_intr interrupt, 0x0: disable interrupt, 0x1: enable interrupt. The BLE_REG_RT_ERR_MASK should also be programmed to enable, desired event bit.

field.name: cdt_expiry_intr_5
field.description: cdt_expiry_intr[5] interrupt, 0x0: disable interrupt, 0x1: enable interrupt

field.name: cdt_expiry_intr_4
field.description: cdt_expiry_intr[4] interrupt, 0x0: disable interrupt, 0x1: enable interrupt

field.name: cdt_expiry_intr_3
field.description: cdt_expiry_intr[3] interrupt, 0x0: disable interrupt, 0x1: enable interrupt

field.name: cdt_expiry_intr_2
field.description: cdt_expiry_intr[2] interrupt, 0x0: disable interrupt, 0x1: enable interrupt

field.name: cdt_expiry_intr_1
field.description: cdt_expiry_intr[1] interrupt, 0x0: disable interrupt, 0x1: enable interrupt

field.name: cdt_expiry_intr_0
field.description: cdt_expiry_intr[0] interrupt, 0x0: disable interrupt, 0x1: enable interrupt

field.name: expiry_intr_3
field.description: expiry_intr[3] interrupt, 0x0: disable interrupt, 0x1: enable interrupt

field.name: expiry_intr_2
field.description: expiry_intr[2] interrupt, 0x0: disable interrupt, 0x1: enable interrupt

field.name: expiry_intr_1
field.description: expiry_intr[1] interrupt, 0x0: disable interrupt, 0x1: enable interrupt

field.name: rx_hdr_done_intr
field.description: rx_hdr_done_intr interrupt configuration, 0x0: route to BLE_REG_INT_STS_0, 0x1: route to BLE_REG_INT_STS_1

field.name: cor_hit_intr
field.description: cor_hit_intr interrupt configuration, 0x0: route to BLE_REG_INT_STS_0, 0x1: route to BLE_REG_INT_STS_1

field.name: tx_pkt_done_intr
field.description: tx_pkt_done_intr interrupt configuration, 0x0: route to BLE_REG_INT_STS_0, 0x1: route to BLE_REG_INT_STS_1

field.name: tx_data_done_intr

field.name: rx_pkt_done_intr
field.description: delay rx_pkt_done_intr interrupt assertion, 0x0: no delay, 0x1: delay interrupt assertion until DMA is done writing timestamp and status fields, into RD.

field.name: tx_pkt_done_intr
field.description: delay tx_pkt_done_intr interrupt assertion, 0x0: no delay, 0x1: delay interrupt assertion until DMA is done writing timestamp and status fields, into TD.

field.name: sw_mbox
field.description: software Mailbox Interrupt, Writing 1 to cause sw_mailbox_intr interrupt to be generated. This bit is self-cleared by hardware.

field.name: timer_en
field.description: Set Timer Enable, This bit is self clearing by hardware after timer expires., 0x0: disable timer, 0x1: enable timer

field.name: expiry_emask_tx
field.description: Event Mask: Tx, Expiration Event Mask for triggering an Tx transaction., 0x0: no event, 0x1: Tx event triggered at timer expiry

field.name: expiry_emask_rx
field.description: Event Mask: Rx, Expiration Event Mask for triggering an Rx transaction., 0x0: no event, 0x1: Rx event triggered at timer expiry

field.name: expiry_emask_intr
field.description: Event Mask: Interrupt, Expiration Event Mask for Interrupt, 0x0: no event, 0x1: interrupt triggered at expiry of timer

field.name: expiry_emask_abort
field.description: Event Mask: Abort, Expiration Event Mask for Abort, 0x0: no event, 0x1: Tx/Rx abort triggered at expiry of timer

field.name: expiry_emask_cs
field.description: Event Mask: CS event for KW PHY, Expiration Event Mask for triggering a CS transaction to KW PHY, 0x0: no event, 0x1: CS event triggered at timer expiry

field.name: slot_mask
field.description: Slot Mask, This register is a 2 bit LSB mask on the clock comparator. If both bits are cleared; then the events will assert regardless of the matching state of the LSB bits., frame,0x0: timer works on frame basis, 0x1: invalid, slot,0x2: timer works on slot basis, halfslot,0x3: timer works on half slot basis

field.name: allow_current_expiry
field.description: Allow current SWT expiry with chained CDT; for CDT Matching mode, SWT configuration for new CDT chaining mode. SWT programming with current native clock values would be considered valid; past expiry_status won't be set. SWT expiry events like TX; RX; HW Abort; and CS still cannot be triggered if programming time half slot is <= current native clock. SWT interrupt will also not get generated at such values (since it is too late). Added for KFOURWONE-2451, 0x0: SWT is configured in original mode where current native clock value is, considered to be in the past, 0x1: SWT is configured in new CDT matching mode where current native clock value is, allowed to trigger chained CDTs

field.name: expiry_value
field.description: Expiry Value, Bluetooth native clock value for event generation. When the Bluetooth native clock equals this value; the events are triggered.

field.name: expiry_status
field.description: Expiry Status, This bit is updated at each expiry. Once set it remains set until this SWT expires again. For the purpose of this register; past value on SWT refers to a value up to 12 hours before the current BTC native clock value., 0x0: SWT expired at programmed value without any errors, 0x1: SWT was programmed for a value that is in the past

field.name: skip_status
field.description: Clock skipping Status, This bit is updated each time the LPO version of nativeClock skips any number of values AND a previously programmed timer expiry got skipped. This is likely to happen only when BTC is entering sleep state when the LPO version of native clock MAY be updated with the most accurate value., 0x0: SWT expired at programmed value without any skipping error, 0x1: Current timer expiry is due to clock skipping over the programmed expiration, value

field.name: swt_conf_valid
field.description: SWT Configuration Valid Indication, Indicates when SWT configurations are registered into sleep clock domain Bit is set when configurations are registered in slow domain and reset at SWT expiry; for both successful expiry as well as past value expiry, 0x0: SWT configuration is not registered into slow clock domain yet, 0x1: SWT configuration is safely registered into slow clock domain

field.description: Event Mask: CS event for KW PHY, Expiration Event Mask for triggering a CS transaction to KW PHY, 0x0: no event, 0x1: CS event triggered at timer expiry

field.name: nat_clock_sleep
field.description: Native quarter microsecond counter Value, This is the quarter miscrosecond timer for FW to read back. The value normally is between 0 to 1249; but it may overflow from this range in sleep mode. This is a read-only register.

field.name: nat_clock_sys_valid
field.description: Status bit for Native Clock Value after wakeup , This status bit indicates that the Bluetooth native clock value in BLE_REG_TMR_NATIVE_CLOCK is a valid value after wakeup from SLEEP. SW may read this status bit to confirm that the native clock value read immediately after wakeup is not a stale value. Reset value is zero. This status is set to 0x1 whenever sleep clock value is captured in sysclk. Reset to 0x0 during SLEEP entry as soon as ble_clk_req de-asserts indcating a stale value in BLE_REG_TMR_NATIVE_CLOCK.

field.name: nat_clock_sleep
field.description: Native Clock Value, Bluetooth native clock value used for timer comparison. This is the sleep clock version of the Bluetooth native clock. To read-verify after a write; it takes at least 2 sleep clock cycles for the write value to return.

register.name: ble_reg_tmr_wakeup_delay_lpo_cycles
register.description: Wakeup delay value in LPO cycles

field.name: wakeup_delay_lpo_cycles
field.description: Wakeup delay in LPO cycles, Number of LPO (sleep clock) cycles from btu_clk_req assertion until the clocks are stable. The minimum recommended value is 2

field.name: old_native_clock
field.description: Native Clock Value (before skip), Bluetooth native clock value before the clock skip was observed. The value after skip can be read in the BLE_REG_TMR_NATIVE_CLOCK register.

field.name: expiry_emask_intr
field.description: Event Mask: Interrupt, Expiration Event Mask for Interrupt, 0x0: no event, 0x1: interrupt triggered at expiry of timer

field.name: expiry_emask_tx
field.description: Event Mask: Tx, Expiration Event Mask for triggering an Tx transaction., 0x0: no event, 0x1: Tx event triggered at timer expiry

field.name: expiry_emask_rx
field.description: Event Mask: Rx, Expiration Event Mask for triggering an Rx transaction., 0x0: no event, 0x1: Rx event triggered at timer expiry

field.name: expiry_emask_abort
field.description: Event Mask: Abort, Expiration Event Mask for triggering an Abort from software., 0x0: no event, 0x1: Abort triggered at timer expiry

field.name: start_emask_ble_txstart
field.description: Event Mask: BLE Tx start, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting at the beginning of a BLE Tx transaction., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down from programmed value at start of next BLE Tx, transaction

field.name: start_emask_ble_rxstart
field.description: Event Mask: BLE Rx start, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting at the beginning of a BLE Rx transaction., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down from programmed value at start of next BLE Rx, transaction

field.name: start_emask_ble_txend
field.description: Event Mask: BLE Tx end, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting at the end of a BLE Tx transaction., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down from programmed value at end of next BLE Tx, transaction

field.name: start_emask_ble_rxend
field.description: Event Mask: BLE Rx end, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting at the end of a BLE Rx transaction., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down from programmed value at end of next BLE Rx, transaction

field.name: start_emask_btc_pktend
field.description: Event Mask: BTC PKT end, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting at the end of a BTC Tx or Rx transaction., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down from programmed value at end of next BTC packet (Tx, or Rx) transaction

field.name: start_emask_ble_corrhit
field.description: Event Mask: BLE CORR hit, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting at BLE correlation hit., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down from programmed value at next BLE correlation hit

field.name: start_emask_bca_req_assert
field.description: Event Mask: BCA request assertion, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting at BCA request assertion., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down from programmed value at next BCA_req assertion

field.name: start_emask_bca_req_deassert
field.description: Event Mask: BCA request deassertion, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting at BCA_req de-assertion., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down from programmed value at next BCA_req de-assertion

field.name: start_emask_ble_corrmiss
field.description: Event Mask: BLE CORR miss, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting at BLE correlation timeout interrupt., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down from programmed value at next BLE correlation miss

field.name: start_emask_sw_trigger
field.description: Event Mask: Software trigger, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting when the firmware sets this bit. This bit is self clearing., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down from the programmed value as soon as this bit is set

field.name: start_emask_hw_abort
field.description: Event Mask: Hardware abort, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting when hardware abort occurs. The abort may be for a transmit packet or a receive packet., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down from the programmed value bit when hardware abort, happens

field.name: cdt_value_reset
field.description: CDT value reset, This bit resets the CDT counter to 0. It will not trigger any expiry conditions (if programmed). This bit is self clearing, 0x0: no event, 0x1: Timer is reset to 0 immediately

field.name: start_emask_ble_cdt0_expiry
field.description: Event Mask: Chain with CDT0, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting when CDT0 expires. This will chain the current CDT with CDT0., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down when CDT0 expires

field.name: start_emask_ble_cdt1_expiry
field.description: Event Mask: Chain with CDT1, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting when CDT1 expires. This will chain the current CDT with CDT1., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down when CDT1 expires

field.name: cdt_matching_mode
field.description: CDT Matching Mode enable, indicates CDT value is not a countdown value; but an absolute value to be matched with the timestamp_qus_cnt_4m counter. Added for KFOURWONE-2451, 0x0: CDT is configured in original Countdown Mode, 0x1: CDT is configured in Matching Mode

field.name: expiry_emask_cs

field.name: cdt_adj_en

field.name: countdown_value

field.description: Event Mask: Rx, Expiration Event Mask for triggering an Rx transaction., 0x0: no event, 0x1: Rx event triggered at timer expiry

field.name: expiry_emask_abort
field.description: Event Mask: Abort, Expiration Event Mask for triggering an Abort from software., 0x0: no event, 0x1: Abort triggered at timer expiry

field.name: start_emask_ble_txstart
field.description: Event Mask: BLE Tx start, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting at the beginning of a BLE Tx transaction., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down from programmed value at start of next BLE Tx, transaction

field.name: start_emask_ble_rxstart
field.description: Event Mask: BLE Rx start, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting at the beginning of a BLE Rx transaction., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down from programmed value at start of next BLE Rx, transaction

field.name: start_emask_ble_txend
field.description: Event Mask: BLE Tx end, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting at the end of a BLE Tx transaction., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down from programmed value at end of next BLE Tx, transaction

field.name: start_emask_ble_rxend
field.description: Event Mask: BLE Rx end, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting at the end of a BLE Rx transaction., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down from programmed value at end of next BLE Rx, transaction

field.name: start_emask_btc_pktend
field.description: Event Mask: BTC PKT end, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting at the end of a BTC Tx or Rx transaction., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down from programmed value at end of next BTC packet (Tx, or Rx) transaction

field.name: start_emask_ble_corrhit
field.description: Event Mask: BLE CORR hit, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting at BLE correlation hit., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down from programmed value at next BLE correlation hit

field.name: start_emask_bca_req_assert
field.description: Event Mask: BCA request assertion, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting at BCA request assertion., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down from programmed value at next BCA_req assertion

field.name: start_emask_bca_req_deassert
field.description: Event Mask: BCA request deassertion, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting at BCA_req de-assertion., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down from programmed value at next BCA_req de-assertion

field.name: start_emask_ble_corrmiss
field.description: Event Mask: BLE CORR miss, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting at BLE correlation timeout interrupt., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down from programmed value at next BLE correlation miss

field.name: start_emask_sw_trigger
field.description: Event Mask: Software trigger, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting when the firmware sets this bit. This bit is self clearing., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down from the programmed value as soon as this bit is set

field.name: start_emask_hw_abort
field.description: Event Mask: Hardware abort, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting when hardware abort occurs. The abort may be for a transmit packet or a receive packet., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down from the programmed value bit when hardware abort, happens

field.name: cdt_value_reset
field.description: CDT value reset, This bit resets the CDT counter to 0. It will not trigger any expiry conditions (if programmed). This bit is self clearing, 0x0: no event, 0x1: Timer is reset to 0 immediately

field.name: start_emask_ble_cdt0_expiry
field.description: Event Mask: Chain with CDT0, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting when CDT0 expires. This will chain the current CDT with CDT0., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down when CDT0 expires

field.name: start_emask_ble_cdt1_expiry
field.description: Event Mask: Chain with CDT1, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting when CDT1 expires. This will chain the current CDT with CDT1., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down when CDT1 expires

field.name: start_emask_ble_cdt2_expiry
field.description: Event Mask: Chain with CDT2, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting when CDT2 expires. This will chain the current CDT with CDT2., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down when CDT2 expires

field.name: start_emask_ble_cdt3_expiry
field.description: Event Mask: Chain with CDT3, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting when CDT3 expires. This will chain the current CDT with CDT3., 0x0: No event, 0x1: timer starts counting down when CDT3 expires

field.name: start_emask_ble_cdt4_expiry
field.description: Event Mask: Chain with CDT4, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting when CDT4 expires. This will chain the current CDT with CDT4., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down when CDT4 expires

field.name: start_emask_ble_cdt5_expiry
field.description: Event Mask: Chain with CDT5, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting when CDT5 expires. This will chain the current CDT with CDT5., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down when CDT5 expires

field.name: start_emask_ble_swt0_expiry
field.description: Event Mask: Chain with SWT0, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting when SWT0 expires. This will chain the current CDT with SWT0., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down when SWT0 expires

field.name: start_emask_ble_swt1_expiry
field.description: Event Mask: Chain with SWT1, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting when SWT1 expires. This will chain the current CDT with SWT1., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down when SWT1 expires

field.name: start_emask_ble_swt2_expiry
field.description: Event Mask: Chain with SWT2, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting when SWT2 expires. This will chain the current CDT with SWT2., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down when SWT2 expires

field.name: start_emask_ble_swt3_expiry
field.description: Event Mask: Chain with SWT3, Start Event Mask for triggering the CDT counter. Start counting when SWT3 expires. This will chain the current CDT with SWT3., 0x0: no event, 0x1: timer starts counting down when SWT3 expires

field.name: cdt_matching_mode
field.description: CDT Matching Mode enable, indicates CDT value is not a countdown value; but an absolute value to be matched with the timestamp_qus_cnt_4m counter. Added for KFOURWONE-2451, 0x0: CDT is configured in original Countdown Mode, 0x1: CDT is configured in Matching Mode

field.name: expiry_emask_cs
field.description: Event Mask: CS event for KW PHY, Expiration Event Mask for triggering a CS transaction to KW PHY., 0x0: no event, 0x1: CS event triggered at timer expiry

field.name: cdt_adj_en
field.description: CDT timing adjustment enable, CDT timing adjustment enable for BLE 2M and BLE LR Tx/Rx for CI = 2;8., 0x0: disable, 0x1: enable

field.name: countdown_value
field.description: Count Down Value, Number of quarter microseconds to count down from. Range is 1 to 8152 qus.

field.name: rx_adj_value
field.description: Rx Count Down Value in QUS, +/- offset. Resolution: 0/25 us

field.name: tx_adj_value
field.description: Tx Count Down Value in QUS, +/- offset. Resolution: 0/25 us

register.name: ble_reg_tmr_cdt_ci_tx_data_adj
register.description: Qus Count Offset Register: LE Coded Tx

field.name: tx_ci_2_adj_value
field.description: Tx Count Down Value in QUS, +/- offset. Resolution: 0/25 us

field.name: tx_ci_8_adj_value
field.description: Tx Count Down Value in QUS, +/- offset. Resolution: 0/25 us

register.name: ble_reg_tmr_cdt_ci_rx_data_adj_0
register.description: Qus Count Offset Register: LE Coded Rx 0

field.name: rx_ci_2_adj_value
field.description: Rx Count Down Value in QUS, +/- offset. Resolution: 0/25 us

field.name: rx_ci_8_adj_value
field.description: Rx Count Down Value in QUS, +/- offset. Resolution: 0/25 us

field.name: rx_ci_adj_emask

field.description: Rx Count Down Value in QUS, +/- offset. Resolution: 0/25 us

field.description: Rx Count Down Value in QUS, +/- offset. Resolution: 0/25 us

field.description: Adjustment Mask: Rx, Last coded bursting bit size for triggering this Rx adjustment.

field.name: cdt_expiry_sts
field.description: CDT Expiry Status in CDT Matching mode, This bit is updated at each CDT expiry; when CDT is programmed in cdt_matching_mode. For the purpose of this register; past value on CDT refers to any value less than the half-slot+qus timestamp at which CDT was programmed. Once set it remains set until this CDT expires again in the matching mode, 0x0: CDT matching was successful, 0x1: CDT matching value was in the past at the time of programming

register.name: ble_reg_ant_switch_tx_cntrl
register.description: Tx Antenna Switch Control, Control register of Bluetooth Tx antenna switching.

field.name: tx_ant_switch_delay_1m
field.description: Antenna Switch Delay from end of Tx Crc, Timer delayed from end of CRC of the current Tx packet to start driving requestAntenna to signal BCA which antenna is used for the Tx extension field., - Resolution: 0.25 usec.

field.name: tx_ant_switch_delay_2m
field.description: Antenna Switch Delay from end of Tx Crc, Timer delayed from end of CRC of the current Tx packet to start driving requestAntenna to signal BCA which antenna is used for the Tx extension field. This delay is for BLE Tx 2 Mbps., - Resolution: 0.25 usec.

field.name: tx_ant_map_length
field.description: Antenna Switch Map Length for Tx DFE, - Valid length of Tx antenna map pattern (max: 40). After executing the antenna switching for this length; BLE will repeat the pattern from the beginning. The map is used when BLE is transmitting extension packets.

field.name: tx_ant_switch_rate
field.description: Antenna Switch Rate, Define the antenna switching rate for extension packet., 0x0: switch antenna every 4 usec, 0x1: switch antenna every 2 usec, 0x2: switch antenna every 1 usec (RFU), 0x3: not valid

field.name: ref_ant
field.description: BCA reference antenna, The value of reference antenna held by the BCA.

field.name: tx_ant_switch_en
field.description: Antenna Switch Enable for Tx DFE, Switch antenna for extension when transmitting location packet., 0x0: disable antenna switch for Tx DFE, 0x1: enable antenna switch for Tx DFE

field.name: tx_ant_switch_index_0
field.description: Antenna Switch Map, Antenna switch map is programmed in a group of 10; 32-bit registers; which represents 40 different values; each value being 5-bit wide for 32 antennas. Switching pattern starts from BLE_REG_ANT_SWITCH_TX_MAP_0; and follows the index order of tx_ant_switch_index_0.1.2.to 3; while BLE_REG_ANT_SWITCH_TX_MAP_0 finishes; continues with the other 4 indexes in BLE_REG_ANT_SWITCH_TX_MAP_1.2.to 9. The pattern length use is determined by tx_ant_map_length.

register.name: ble_reg_ant_switch_rx_cntrl
register.description: Rx Antenna Switch Control, Control register of Bluetooth Rx antenna switching.

field.name: rx_ant_switch_delay_1m
field.description: Antenna Switch Delay from start of Rx Crc, Timer delayed from start of CRC of the current Rx packet to start driving requestAntenna to signal BCA which antenna is used for the expected Rx extension field., - Resolution: 0.25 usec.

field.name: rx_ant_switch_delay_2m
field.description: Antenna Switch Delay from start of Rx Crc, Timer delayed from start of CRC of the current Rx packet to start driving requestAntenna to signal BCA which antenna is used for the expected Rx extension field. This delay is for BLE Rx 2 Mbps., - Resolution: 0.25 usec.

field.name: rx_ant_map_length
field.description: Antenna Switch Map Length for Rx DFE, - Valid length of Rx antenna map pattern (max: 40). After executing the antenna switching for this length; BLE will repeat the pattern from the beginning. The map is used when BLE is receiving extension packets.

field.name: rx_ant_switch_rate
field.description: Antenna Switch Rate, Define the antenna switching rate for extension packet., 0x0: switch antenna every 4 usec, 0x1: switch antenna every 2 usec, 0x2: switch antenna every 1 usec (RFU), 0x3: not valid

field.name: ref_ant
field.description: BCA reference antenna, The value of reference antenna held by BCA.

field.name: rx_ant_switch_en
field.description: Antenna Switch Enable for Rx DFE, Switch antenna for extension when receiving location packet., 0x0: disable antenna switch for Rx DFE, 0x1: enable antenna switch for Rx DFE

Switching pattern starts from BLE_REG_ANT_SWITCH_RX_MAP_0; and follows the index order of rx_ant_switch_index_0.1.2.to 3; while BLE_REG_ANT_SWITCH_RX_MAP_0 finishes; continues with the other 4 indexes in BLE_REG_ANT_SWITCH_RX_MAP_1.2.to 9. The pattern length use is determined by rx_ant_map_length.

register.description: Periodic SW Timer 0: First Anchor Offset

field.name: anchr_corr_time
field.description: Anchor Point To Correlation Hit Time

enumeratedValue.name: zero
enumeratedValue.description: Substract adj_ast_ofst from ISO_Intvl_Tmr value counting toward next BIS/CIS event, effectively moving next BIS/CIS anchor point to a earlier time. This is used when the averaged anchr_corr_time value is gradually decreasing, indicating the slave device's local clock is drifting slower.

enumeratedValue.name: one
enumeratedValue.description: Add adj_ast_ofst to ISO_Intvl_Tmr value counting toward next BIS/CIS event, effectively delaying next BIS/CIS anchor point to a later time. This is used when the averaged anchr_corr_time value is gradually increasing, indicating the slave device's local clock is drifting faster.

This is used when the averaged anchr_corr_time value is gradually decreasing, indicating the slave device's local clock is drifting slower.

field.name: sw_dbus_count

field.name: sw_dbus_rst
field.description: software dBus reset, If set; software dBus FSM will reset and transition to idle state. Software dBus finish will be issued. Firmware first writes 1 and then writes 0 to this bit.

field.name: sw_dbus_finished
field.description: Poll status of dBus access, When set; the dBus read or write access is finished. This bit is reset when writing to BTU_RIF_SWDBUS_CTL reg for the next access., 0x0: busy, 0x1: finished

field.name: sw_dbus_event
field.description: Event to trigger software dBus access, SWDBUS_EVENT_NONPKT,0x0: SWDBUS_EVENT_NONPKT (when there is no packet activity), SWDBUS_EVENT_PKT_ASAP,0x1: SWDBUS_EVENT_PKT_ASAP (as soon as possible during packet activity), SWDBUS_EVENT_PKT_START,0x2: SWDBUS_EVENT_PKT_START (when rif_startCount equals sw_dbus_count), SWDBUS_EVENT_PKT_END,0x3: SWDBUS_EVENT_PKT_END (when rif_endCount equals sw_dbus_count)

field.description: Software Access Data, Set write data (write access); or get the read data (read access)., Updated automatically during read., Bits[7:0] of 3rd 8-bit word.

field.name: sw_dbus_wdata3
field.description: Software Access Data, Set write data (write access); or get the read data (read access)., Updated automatically during read., Bits[7:0] of 4th 8-bit word.

field.name: sw_dbus_wdata4
field.description: Software Access Data, Set write data (write access); or get the read data (read access)., Updated automatically during read., Bits[7:0] of 5th 8-bit word.

field.name: sw_dbus_wdata5
field.description: Software Access Data, Set write data (write access); or get the read data (read access)., Updated automatically during read., Bits[7:0] of 6th 8-bit word.

field.name: sw_dbus_wdata6
field.description: Software Access Data, Set write data (write access); or get the read data (read access)., Updated automatically during read., Bits[7:0] of 7th 8-bit word.

field.name: sw_dbus_wdata7
field.description: Software Access Data, Set write data (write access); or get the read data (read access)., Updated automatically during read., Bits[7:0] of 8th 8-bit word.
