field.name: rx_pkt_pld_len_addr
field.description: Radio Register Address for Rx Packet Payload Length, The LSB BRF register of the expected Rx Packet Payload Length. The immediate next BRF registers is also allocated for MSB length portion., - Units: micro-seconds.

register.name: btu_rif_rx_sync_pulse_timer
register.description: RIF BRF Rx Sync Pulse Timer

field.name: rx_hdr_pulse_timeout
field.description: Rx Header Pulse Timeout, After correlation hit; timeout counter for the header sync pulse from the BRF. The BRF header start pulse is received when the packet header is sent on rx_data. If the header start pulse is not detected; then the packet would be aborted. This timeout specifies how long the BTU will wait before an abort., - Resolution: 1 us.

field.name: rx_sync_pulse_timeout
field.description: Rx Sync Pulse Timeout, After header start pulse; timeout counter for the payload sync pulse from the BRF. The BRF payload sync pulse is received when the packet payload is sent on rx_data. If the payload sync pulse is not detected; then the packet would be aborted. This timeout specifies how long the BTU will wait before an abort., - Resolution: 1 us.

field.name: hdr_start_pos_adj
field.description: Positive Phase Adjustment after Header starts Pulse, Positive phase adjustment after header starts pulse. The sampling point is delayed by the shift amount., - Resolution: 0.25 us (Gen3); 62.5 ns (Gen4).

field.name: hdr_start_neg_adj
field.description: Negative Phase Adjustment after Header starts Pulse, Negative phase adjustment after header starts pulse. The sampling point is advanced by the shift amount., - Resolution: 0.25 us.

field.name: sync_start_pos_adj
field.description: Positive Phase Adjustment after Payload Sync starts Pulse, Positive phase adjustment after payload sync starts pulse. The sampling point is delayed by the shift amount., - Resolution: 0.25 us (Gen3); 62.5 ns (Gen4).

field.name: sync_start_neg_adj
field.description: Negative Phase Adjustment after Header Starts Pulse, Negative phase adjustment after payload sync starts pulse. The sampling point is advanced by the shift amount., - Resolution: 0.25 us (Gen3); 62.5 ns (Gen4).

field.name: pdu_start_pos_adj
field.description: Positive Phase Adjustment after PDU Data starts Pulse, Positive phase adjustment after PDU data starts pulse. The sampling point is delayed by the shift amount., - Resolution: 0.25 us (Gen3); 62.5 ns (Gen4).

field.name: pdu_start_neg_adj
field.description: Negative Phase Adjustment after PDU Data starts Pulse, Negative phase adjustment after PDU data starts pulse. The sampling point is advanced by the shift amount., - Resolution: 0.25 us.

field.name: dfe_1m_phase_pos_adj
field.description: Positive Phase Adjustment for DFE I/Q Samples After CRC, Positive Phase Adjustment for 1 Mbps DFE I/Q samples after CRC. The sampling point is delayed by the shift amount., - Resolution: 62.5 ns (Gen4).

field.name: dfe_1m_phase_neg_adj
field.description: Negative Phase Adjustment for DFE I/Q Samples After CRC, Positive Phase Adjustment for 1 Mbps DFE I/Q samples after CRC. The sampling point is advanced by the shift amount., - Resolution: 62.5 ns (Gen4).

field.name: dfe_2m_phase_pos_adj
field.description: Positive Phase Adjustment for DFE I/Q Samples After CRC, Positive Phase Adjustment for 2 Mbps DFE I/Q samples after CRC. The sampling point is delayed by the shift amount., - Resolution: 62.5 ns (Gen4).

field.name: dfe_2m_phase_neg_adj
field.description: Negative Phase Adjustment for DFE I/Q Samples After CRC, Positive Phase Adjustment for 2 Mbps DFE I/Q samples after CRC. The sampling point is advanced by the shift amount., - Resolution: 62.5 ns (Gen4).

field.name: rx_dbus_pull_in_time
field.description: Rx dBUS events pull-in time, This adjusts the pull-in time of the dBUS events including SOC_BT_BRF_PU; A3; A1; A2 and P pulse before Rx packet. This setting applies to both BTC and BLE packet. Resolution: 0.25us

field.name: ble_pull_in_en
field.description: BLE dBUS events pull-in enable, Enable BLE Rx packet dBUS events pull-in when current BLE packet's frequency matches one of the 4 TONE_CANCEL_CHNL values., 0x0: disable, 0x1: enable

field.name: tone_cancel_chnl0
field.description: Rx Tone Cancellation Channel 0, If Rx packet's channel index value sent to BRF on A2 event matches this value; the Rx packet dBUS event will be pulled-in; upon enabled.

field.name: tone_cancel_chnl1
field.description: Rx Tone Cancellation Channel 1, If Rx packet's channel index value sent to BRF on A2 event matches this value; the Rx packet dBUS event will be pulled-in; upon enabled.

field.name: tone_cancel_chnl2
field.description: Rx Tone Cancellation Channel 2, If Rx packet's channel index value sent to BRF on A2 event matches this value; the Rx packet dBUS event will be pulled-in; upon enabled.

field.name: tone_cancel_chnl3
field.description: Rx Tone Cancellation Channel 3, If Rx packet's channel index value sent to BRF on A2 event matches this value; the Rx packet dBUS event will be pulled-in; upon enabled.

field.name: ble_brf_pu
field.description: BLE BRF Power up, This bit used by the BLE software to control the power up bit for the BRF., 0x0: disable, 0x1: enable

field.name: ble_pll_req
field.description: BLE PLL Clock Request, This bit is used by the BLE software to control the PLL clock enable., 0x0: disable, 0x1: enable

field.name: data_loopback_en
field.description: BLE Loopback Data Enable, Setting this bit changes the source of the BLE Rx data from the Tx block instead of from the BRF., 0x0: Rx data is from BRF, 0x1: Rx data is from Tx block

field.name: rx_iq_sample_phase
field.description: BLE Rx IQ Sampling Rate Phase, To use in conjunction with rx_iq_sample_rate[1:0] in 'BLE_REG_DFE_PKT_EXTENSION_CNTRL'; define IQ sample reception phase in Rx extension field., When rx_iq_sample_rate[1:0] == 0; receiving IQ samples every 4 usec; on the phase rx_iq_sample_phase[1:0] herein specified (i.e. 0~3)., When rx_iq_sample_rate[1:0] == 1; receiving IQ samples every 2 usec; on the phase rx_iq_sample_phase[0] herein specified (i.e. 0: on even phase; 1: on odd phase)., When rx_iq_sample_rate[1:0] == 0; receiving IQ samples every 1 usec on every phase; rx_iq_sample_phase[1:0] is ignored.

field.name: ble_tx_pwr_adj_en
field.description: BLE TX power adjust enable, Global enable for BLE Tx power adjustment scheme - outputting Tx_power_level to BCA at bt_req and overwriting with Bfdbk_Tx_power if Bfdbk_Tx_power_ind., 0x0: disable, 0x1: enable

field.name: ble_ignore_bca_tx_pwr
field.description: BLE ignore BCA TX power, FW overide to ignore BCA's Bfdbk_Tx_power if Bfdbk_Tx_power_ind; for current BLE Tx pkt., 0x0: disable, 0x1: enable

field.name: ble_cor_indicator
field.description: BLE Correlator Indicator, BLE correlator indicator to enable which correlator is used., 0x0: no correlator enabled, 0x1: correlator one enabled, 0x2: correlator two enabled, 0x3: both correlators enabled

field.name: ble_access_code_0_16
field.description: BLE Access Code, BLE Access Code to be used in correlator for the current Rx packet (lower 16-bit).

field.name: ble_access_code_17_32
field.description: BLE Access Code, BLE Access Code to be used in correlator for the current Rx packet(upper 16-bit).

field.name: ble_cor_window_0
field.description: BLE Correlation Window Size, BLE correlation window size for the current Rx packet (lower 16-bit)., Correlation window in 1/4 usec. Hardware will automatically abort Rx operation up expiration of this window time. Maximum window size: 2^26/4 = 16777216 usec.

field.name: ble_cor_window_1
field.description: BLE Correlation Window Size, BLE correlation window size for the current Rx packet (Upper 10-bit)., Correlation window in 1/4 usec. Hardware will automatically abort Rx operation up expiration of this window time. Maximum window size: 2^26/4 = 16777216 usec.

field.name: tx_clk_en_delay_qus
field.description: Tx_clk_en Delay Offset, This is the delay offset for the tx_clk_en signal from the Tx S pulse., - Resolution: 1/4 usec.

field.name: rx_clk_en_delay_qus
field.description: Rx_clk_en Delay Offset, This is the delay offset for the rx_clk_en signal from the Rx P pulse., - Resolution: 1/4 usec.

field.name: rif_tx_go_delay_qus
field.description: RIF_TX_GO Delay Offset, This is the delay offset for the rif_tx_go signal from the Tx S pulse., - Res: 1/4 usec.

field.name: rif_rx_go_delay_qus
field.description: RIF_RX_GO Delay Offset, This is the delay offset for the rif_rx_go signal from the Rx P pulse., - Res: 1/4 usec.

register.name: btu_rif_ble_dbus_tx_pwrctl_wdata
register.description: Tx Power Control DBUS Write Data

field.name: rif_dbus_tx_pwrctl_wdata
field.description: Tx Power Control DBUS Write Data, Tx A1 pulse., - Bits[9:8]: Tx data rate, - Bits[7:0]: Tx power table index, 0x0: reserved, 0x1: BDR 1 Mbps / BLE 1 Mbps / ANT 1 Mbps, 0x2: EDR 2 Mbps / BLE 2 Mbps, 0x3: EDR 3 Mbps

field.name: rif_dbus_tx_fsyn_wdata
field.description: Tx Fsyn DBUS Write Data, Tx A2 pulse., - Bits[15:13]: Bluetooth mode - BTC; BLE; NIKE; ANT or LLR, - Bit[12]: Rx notch filter enable, - Bit[11]: reserved, - Bit[10]: power up BRF BG/CPREG, - Bits[9:8]: Bluetooth state - Tx; Rx, - Bit[7]: large correlation window indicator, - Bits[6:0]: Bluetooth channel from 0 to 78

register.name: btu_rif_ble_dbus_rx_pwrctl_wdata
register.description: Rx Power Control DBUS Write Data

field.name: rif_dbus_rx_pwrctl_wdata
field.description: Rx Power Control DBUS Write Data, Rx A1 pulse., - Bits[15:14]: reserved, - Bit[13]: BLE MI estimation enable, - Bit[11]: Rx link BDR/EDR packet type, - Bit[10]: Rx channel estimation using noise floor, - Bits[9:8]: indicate which syncword correlator to use, - Bits[7:4]: Rx link index from 0 to 9, - Bits[1:0]: Rx power mode (when low power scan mode is normal mode; selects from either normal or performance mode), ,Enum, - Bit[12]: BLE Rx data rate, 0x0: 1 Mbps (also for BTC; ANT), 0x1: 2 Mbps, ,Enum, - Bits[2]: BLE channel assessment mode, 0x0: Single channel, 0x1: V_1, Multiple channels (ch; ch+1; ch+2 ... ch+9)

field.name: rif_dbus_rx_fsyn_wdata
field.description: Rx Fsyn DBUS Write Data, Rx A2 pulse., - Bits[15:13]: Bluetooth mode - BTC; BLE; NIKE; ANT or LLR, - Bit[12]: Rx notch filter enable, - Bit[11]: reserved, - Bit[10]: power up BRF BG/CPREG, - Bits[9:8]: Bluetooth state - Tx; Rx, - Bit[7]: large correlation window indicator, - Bit[6:0]: Bluetooth channel from 0 to 78

field.name: ble_rx_syncpulse_delay
field.description: The BLE packet PDU sync pulse max delay from correlation hit pulse. Watchdog timer value for sync pulse from BRF at the start of PDU. Hardware will automatically abort Rx operation upon expiration of the watchdog timer. Res: 1 usec.

field.name: ble_rx_datavld_delay
field.description: In Rx bursting mode; the BLE packet PDU bursting data valid max delay from last end of data valid or sync pulse. Watchdog timer value for sync pulse from BRF at the start of PDU. Hardware will automatically abort Rx operation upon expiration of the watchdog timer. Res: 1 usec.

field.name: ble_tx_pwr_adjd
field.description: BLE Tx power adjusted status, This bit indicates that BLE TX power was adjusted by BCA feedback. This bit is cleared on read. It is valid shortly after BCA grant is received; for each BLE TX packet.

field.name: bfdbk_tx_power_4m_ble_rdbk
field.description: BCA Feedback power for BLE packet, Feedback power value received from BCA for BLE TX packet. This value is overwritten when new BLE power level override is feedback from BCA.

field.name: rx_cte_len_addr
field.description: Radio Register Address for Rx CTE Length, The BRF register of the expected Rx CTE length., - Units: 8 micro-seconds.

register.name: btu_rif_arb_ble_start_time_coded
register.description: RIF ARB BLE Start Time, Delay till sampled bt_grant_n is sampled.

field.name: ble_tx_start_time
field.description: Delay when bt_grant_n is sampled and rif_tx_req will start after start_rif_tx (Tx Request from BLE to RIF-ARB for radio access) is issued from BLE., - Resolution: 1/4 us.

field.name: ble_rx_start_time
field.description: Delay when bt_grant_n is sampled and rif_rx_req will start after start_rif_rx (Rx request from BLE to RIF-ARB for Radio access) is issued., - Resolution : 1/4 us.

register.name: btu_rif_arb_ble_start_time_1m
register.description: RIF ARB BLE Start Time, Delay till sampled bt_grant_n is sampled.

field.name: ble_tx_start_time
field.description: Delay when bt_grant_n is sampled and rif_tx_req will start after start_rif_tx (Tx Request from BLE to RIF-ARB for radio access) is issued from BLE., - Resolution: 1/4 us.

field.name: ble_rx_start_time
field.description: Delay when bt_grant_n is sampled and rif_rx_req will start after start_rif_rx (Rx request from BLE to RIF-ARB for Radio access) is issued., - Resolution : 1/4 us.

register.name: btu_rif_arb_ble_start_time_2m
register.description: RIF ARB BLE Start Time, Delay till sampled bt_grant_n is sampled.

field.name: ble_tx_start_time
field.description: Delay when bt_grant_n is sampled and rif_tx_req will start after start_rif_tx (Tx Request from BLE to RIF-ARB for radio access) is issued from BLE., - Resolution: 1/4 us.

field.name: ble_rx_start_time
field.description: Delay when bt_grant_n is sampled and rif_rx_req will start after start_rif_rx (Rx request from BLE to RIF-ARB for Radio access) is issued., - Resolution : 1/4 us.

field.name: ble_sw_abort
field.description: If set; current BLE traffic will be aborted and ble_sw_abort_intr will be issued., This bit cleared by hardware; after ble_sw_abort_intr is issued., If there is no ongoing BLE traffic; then there is no abort happening. But ble_sw_abort_intr will be issued anyway. It is software requirement to issue ble_sw_abort_intr weather there was ongoing BLE traffic got aborted or not.

field.name: rst_rif_arb_fsm
field.description: RIF-ARB Reset, If set; RIF-ARB fsm will reset and transition to idle state. Firmware first writes 1 and then writes 0 to this bit.

field.name: ble_sync_frame_en
field.description: Enable ble_sync_frame in arbitration decision, Enable considering ble_sync_frame in arbitration decision, 0x0: disable, 0x1: enable

field.name: rif_collide
field.description: KW47 Deadlock condition detection; with interrupt generation on ble_cutoff, This bit is set if there is a rising edge on rif_tx or rx during an on-going transaction. This bit gets cleared with a WtiteOne

register.name: btu_rif_cca_grant_offset_time
register.description: BTU CCA GRANT OFFSET TIME, BTU CCA Grant Offset Time

field.name: ble_cca_grant_offset_time
field.description: BLE CCA Grant Offset time, Offset to the delay when bt_grant_n is sampled and rif_tx_start will start after rifTx (Tx request from BLE to RIF-ARB for radio access) is issued from BLE. This offset is only used in TX packets; and when ble_tx_cca_en is also set to 1., - Resolution: 0.25us

register.name: btu_rif_cca_tx_fesw_offset_time
register.description: BTU CCA TX FESW OFFSET TIME, BTU CCA TX FESW Offset Time

field.name: ble_cca_tx_fesw_offset_time
field.description: BLE CCA TX FESW Offset time, Offset to the delay assertion of bttx_fesw in CCA mode to curb during CCA (RX) operation is ongoing. This offset is added on to tx_fesw_on_delay. This offset is only used in BLE TX packets; and when ble_tx_cca_en is also set to 1., - Resolution: 1us

field.name: btu_testbus_sel_0
field.description: RIF Testbus Select; Lower Bits, Lower 15 bits of btu_testbus_sel; if, (btu_testbus_sel[i*2];btu_testbus_sel[i*2+1]) set to:, 0x0: get btc_testbus_out[i], 0x1: get ble_testbus_out[i], 0x2: get ble_debug_sw_msg_out(URAT), 0x3: get ble_test_sw_out[i]

field.name: btu_testbus_sel_1
field.description: RIF Testbus Select; Upper Bits, Upper 15 bits of btu_testbus_sel; if, (btu_testbus_sel[i*2];btu_testbus_sel[i*2+1]) set to:, 0x0: get btc_testbus_out[i], 0x1: get ble_testbus_out[i], 0x2: get ble_debug_sw_msg_out(URAT), 0x3: get ble_test_sw_out[i]

field.name: btu_testbus_oe_
field.description: Debug testbus output enable, Active low BTU testbus output enables.

field.name: testbus_sw_out
field.description: BLE debug software control testbus ouput, Only when btu_testbus_overrdie_by_ble_sw = 1; this software testbus is the BLE testbus output.

field.name: debug_sw_msg
field.description: Debug message, Software message is written into this register and transfered into FIFO.

register.name: btu_rif_reg_debug_sw_msg_fifo_cnt
register.description: BLE Debug Software Message FIFO Count

field.name: btu_rif_testbus_en
field.description: Enable debug mode to use BTU testbus

field.name: bt_reg_aes_clk_en
field.description: AES Clock Enable, If set; Force bt_aes_clk to turn on., Otherwise; bt_aes_clk_en controls bt_aes_clk gating.

field.name: bt_reg_rif_rx_4m_clk_en
field.description: RIF Rx 4M Clock Enable, 0x0: rif_rx_4m_clk_en controls clock gating, 0x1: forces rif_rx_4m_clk to turn on

field.name: bt_reg_rif_rx_16m_clk_en
field.description: RIF Rx 16M Clock Enable, 0x0: rif_rx_16m_clk_en controls clock gating for rif_rx_16m_clk, 0x1: forces rif_rx_16m_clk to turn on

field.name: bt_reg_force_ebram_sysclk_en
field.description: Force EBRAM ebSysClk enable, When set; ebSysClk to EBRAM is always ON; it is not gated.

field.name: bt_reg_aes_sys_clk_en
field.description: Force aes sys clk enable, When set; sys clk to hw aes arbiter is always ON; it is not gated.

register.name: btu_rif_clk_smpld
register.description: RIF Clock Sampled, Mux select for Sampled generation logic.

field.name: btu_4m_smpld_mux
field.description: 4M Sampled MUX, Mux select to select the sync method., First method does not require the clocks to be in phase., Second wethod requires cloks to be in phase (synchronization between 4 MHz clock and ebSysClkIn)., If this bit is set to 1; it uses first method., This signal is used for both BTC and BLE.

field.name: rif_rx_4m_smpld_mux
field.description: RIF Rx 4M Sampled MUX, Mux select to select sync methods., First method does not require clocks to be in phase., Second method requires clocks to be in phase (Used in synchronization between 16 MHz and 4 MHz clock. Used for sampling Gen4 data.), If set to 1; select first method.

register.name: btu_rif_ble_clk_gating
register.description: RIF BLE Clock Gating, Clock Enable register for BLE Clocks.

field.name: bt_reg_ble_sleep_clk_en
field.description: BLE Sleep Clock Enable, If set; forces ble_sleep_clk to turn on.

field.name: bt_reg_ble_force_clk_en
field.description: BLE Force Clock Enable, If set; forces all BLE internal clocks to turn on.

field.name: bt_reg_ble_slv_hclk_en
field.description: BLE Slave HCLK Enable, 0x0: ble_slv_hclk_en controls clock gating dynamically, 0x1: forces ble_sys_td_clk_en to turn on

field.name: bt_reg_ble_mst_hclk_en
field.description: BLE Master HCLK Enable, 0x0: ble_mst_hclk_en controls clock gating, 0x1: forces ble_mst_hclk to 1

field.name: bt_reg_ble_ric_sys_clk_en
field.description: BLE RIC System Clock Enable, 0x0: ble_ric_sys_clk_en controls dynamic clock gating, 0x1: force ble_ric_sys_clk to turn on

field.name: bt_reg_ble_tx_clk_en
field.description: BLE Tx Clock Enable, 0x0: ble_tx_clk_en controls clock gating for ble_tx_clk, 0x1: forces ble_tx_clk; also forces ble_td_sys_clk_en to be set

field.name: bt_reg_ble_rx_clk_en
field.description: BLE Rx Clock Enable, 0x0: ble_rx_clk controls clock gating dynamically, 0x1: forces ble_rx_clk clocks to turn on; also forces ble_rd_sys_clk to turn on

field.name: bt_reg_ble_td_sys_clk_en
field.description: BLE TD System Clock Enable, 0x0: ble_td_sys_clk_en controls clock gating dynamically, 0x1: forces ble_td_sys_clk to turn on

field.name: bt_reg_ble_rd_sys_clk_en
field.description: BLE RD System Clock Enable, 0x0: ble_rd_sys_clk_en controls dynamic clock gating, 0x1: forces ble_rd_sys_clk to turn on

field.name: bt_reg_ble_rl_sys_clk_en
field.description: BLE RD System Clock Enable, 0x0: ble_rl_sys_clk_en controls dynamic clock gating, 0x1: forces forces ble_rl_sys_clk to turn on

field.name: bt_reg_ble_wl_sys_clk_en
field.description: BLE Whitelist Search System Clock Enable, 0x0: ble_wl_sys_clk_en controls dynamic clock gating, 0x1: forces ble_wl_sys_clk to turn on

field.name: bt_reg_ble_irk_sys_clk_en
field.description: BLE IRK resolve System Clock Enable, 0x0: ble_irk_sys_clk_en controls dynamic clock gating, 0x1: forces ble_irk_sys_clk to turn on

field.name: bt_reg_ble_tmrs_clk_en
field.description: BLE cdt and pst timers clock enable, 0x0: ble_tmr_4m_clk_en controls dynamic clock gating, 0x1: forces ble_tmr_4m_clk_en to turn on

field.name: bt_reg_ble_tmrreg_sys_clk_en
field.description: BLE timer registers clock enable, 0x0: BTU controls dynamic sysclk gating on SWT; CDT and PST registers, 0x1: forces SWT; CDT and PST registers sysclk to turn on

register.name: btu_rif_ble_clk_ctrl
register.description: RIF BLE Clock Control, Register for Clock Control Logic

field.name: bt_reg_force_ble_clk_req_zero
field.description: Force BLE Clock Req Zero, ble_sp_req is set to put BLE to sleep. When a write (1 or 0) to this register is detected; BLE will set ble_clk_req to 0 and go to sleep. This will gate off all BLE clocks.

field.name: bt_reg_force_ble_clk_req_one
field.description: Force BLE Clock Req One, When set; ble_clk_req will always be forced to 1.

field.name: ble_awake_sts
field.description: BLE Awake Status, This bit indicates if BLE is in sleep or awake.

field.name: ble_clk_req_early_assert
field.description: ble_clk_req early assertion upon any BLE AHB access, Setting this bit will enable ble_clk_req early assertion upon any BLE AHB access; which allows bt_clk_req to be asserted earlier to APU.

field.name: ble_sys_4m_early_ungate
field.description: ble_sys_clk and ble_4m_clk early ungated upon any BLE AHB access, Setting this bit will allow ble_sys_clk and ble_4m_clk being ungated earlier upon any BLE AHB access during BLE sleep for faster BLE register access.

register.name: btu_rif_ble_dbus_tx_pkt_end
register.description: BLE RIF dBus Tx Packet End Control

field.name: dbus_tx_pkt_end_delay
field.description: dBus Tx Packet End Delay, Time from the end of active Tx payload to dBus command that sets the radio back to IDLE., - Resolution: 0.25 us.

register.name: btu_rif_ble_dbus_rx_pkt_end
register.description: BLE RIF dBus Rx Packet End Control

field.name: dbus_rx_pkt_end_delay
field.description: dBus Rx Packet End Delay, Time from the end of active Rx payload to dBus command that sets the radio back to IDLE., - Resolution: 0.25 us.

register.name: btu_rif_ble_dbus_tx_rampdown
register.description: BLE RIF dBus Tx Rampdown Control

field.name: dbus_tx_rampdown_delay
field.description: dBus Tx Rampdown Delay, Delay time after the end of a Tx slot for ramping down the radio over the dBus., Resolution 0.25 us.

field.name: dbus_rssi_delay
field.description: Delay from RSSI trigger to start of RSSI read, Delay from the end of rif_rx_req to enable dBus RSSI read back., Resolution 0.25 us.

register.name: btu_rif_adaptivity_ctrl
register.description: BT Adaptivity Control, Register for BT Adaptivity Control

field.name: ble_cca_dis
field.description: BLE CCA disable bit, FW override to disable CCA for current BLE Tx pkt. - Revert to normal Tx timing; clear A1 cca_before_tx_en bit; ignore brf_bt_cca_tx_drop; and no R2 DBUS. FW should set this bit before start_rif_tx time; and clear this bit before the next TX packet's start_rif_tx time.

field.name: cca_ed_factor
field.description: Forgetfactor for CCA NF linear mean averaging, Controls how many previous NF readings in the same channel are considered for NF linear mean averaging

field.name: ble_cca_ebram_rst_dyn
field.description: Reset bit for BLE CCA abort counters, Reset all BLE CCA abort counters in EBRAM. This bit is self clearing.

field.name: ble_cca_ebram_stat_en
field.description: Enable bit for BLE CCA EBRAM STATISTICS, Enable BLE CCA abort counters and NF averaging in EBRAM.

field.name: ble_tx_nf_en
field.description: BLE NF during TX enable, Reading inband power in each TX channel gives the Noise Floor in that channel. This can be used for NF measurement; replacing scheduled NF measurement slots in BLE. When this bit is set; design works in NF mode. CCA is performed and NF is read back. brf_bt_cca_tx_drop indication from BRF is ignored. This bit is meant to be used together with ble_tx_cca_en bit ble_tx_cca_en = 1; ble_tx_nf_en = x:CCA is done; NF is read back; brf abort indication aborts TX (EU regulatory mode) ble_tx_cca_en = 0; ble_tx_nf_en = 1:CCA is done; NF is read back; brf abort indication ignored (Non EU countries can use this mode) ble_tx_cca_en = 0; ble_tx_nf_en = 0:CCA is not done before TX. Old behavior (legacy)

field.name: ble_tx_cca_en
field.description: BLE CCA before TX enable, Global enable for BLE CCA before Tx scheme - new CA1; CA2 to BRF; bt_pll_req; brf_pu; fesw; bca_bt_grant_n new Tx timing to BCA/BRF; CCA abort handling (to BCA); new R2 DBUS; cca abort statistic in EBRAM and NF averaged in EBRAM

register.name: btu_rif_ble_cca_ed_readback
register.description: BLE ED Mag readback value, BLE ED Mag readback value

field.name: ble_cca_ed_mag
field.description: BLE CCA ED Magnitude, BLE CCA ED Magnitude readback from R2 DBUS)

field.name: ble_cca_ed_vld
field.description: BLE CCA ED valid, BLE CCA ED valid indication. If packet is aborted before R2 time; the ble_cca_ed_mag may be invalid. This bit is set to 1 when ble_cca_ed_mag is valid.

field.name: dbus_cca_tx_fsyn_wr_en
field.description: CCA TX FSYN Dbus Enable, Enable CA2 DBUS. CA2 is performed only when this bit is set and also BT adaptivity features is enabled for the current controller (BTC or BLE)

register.description: CCA TX R2 Dbus, CCA TX R2 Dbus

field.name: dbus_cca_ed_delay
field.description: CCA TX R2 Dbus Delay, Delay value to position R2 timing. The delay is counted from the end of S pulse on BTU-BRF interface.

field.name: dbus_cca_ed_en
field.description: CCA TX R2 Dbus Enable, Enable R2 DBUS. R2 is performed only when this bit is set and also BT adaptivity features is enabled for the current controller (BTC or BLE)

field.name: rif_ca1_2_offset_for_abort_b4_cca_us
field.description: CA1 CA2 offset for the case of abort before CCA TX, Additional offset to delay CA1 and CA2 when CCA pkt was after a bt rif abort or FFU bca abort. The default is to delay CA1;2 in these cases by 10us to allow BRF MCU to accept these DBUS timely.

register.name: btu_rif_ble_cca_ebram_addr
register.description: BLE CCA EBRAM Address Offset, BLE CCA EBRAM Address Offset

field.description: BLE CCA EBRAM Address Offset, This register is the EBRAM offset value for BLE CCA statistics location.

field.name: rif_ble_cca_abort_pkt_cnt_thd
field.description: BLE CCA abort packet count threshold, 8-bit value of threshold to be used along with EBRAM abort statistics. BTU will generate ble_cca_abort_thd_cnt_met interrupt to SW when the number of CCA aborted packets in any single channel have reached or exceeded this threshold value.

field.name: rif_ble_cca_tx_pkt_cnt_thd
field.description: BLE CCA TX packet count threshold, 8-bit value of threshold to be used along with EBRAM abort statistics. BTU will generate ble_cca_tx_cnt_thd_met interrupt to SW when the number of total CCA TX packets in any single channel have reached or exceeded this threshold value.

register.name: btu_rif_cca_ble_threshold_met_sts
register.description: BLE CCA threshold met status, BLE CCA threshold met status

field.name: rif_ble_cca_abort_cnt_thd_met_ch

field.name: rif_ble_cca_tx_cnt_thd_met_ch
field.description: BLE CCA TX count threshold met channel number, BLE channel read-back value; on which the CCA total TX packet count threshold was met; causing ble_cca_txpkt_thd_met interrupt to CPU

field.name: ble_btrx_fesw_during_cca_off_delay
field.description: BLE btrx_fesw OFF delay for CCA TX packets, Number of microseconds from wakeUp to turning off btrx_fesw for CCA portion of BLE Tx packets

field.name: reg_bt_tx_pwr_gate_en
field.description: BT tx power enable for BCA, BT tx power enable for BCA, 0x0: Bt tx power is disabled, 0x1: Bt tx power is enabled

field.name: bt_reg_pta_rx_4m_clk_en
field.description: PTA Clock Gate Enable Override, PTA Clock Gate Enable Override; if set to 1; clock gating for PTA clocks is disabled = ungated clocks.

field.name: bt_grant_bypass_en
field.description: BCA coex grant bypass enable, When bt_grant_bypass_en is set; BCA coex grant bca_bt_grant_n is controlled by bt_grant_bypass_val register., 0x0: disable bt_grant_n bypass, 0x1: enable bt_grant_n bypass

field.name: bt_grant_bypass_val
field.description: BCA coex grant bypass value, When bt_grant_bypass_en is set; BCA coex grant bca_bt_grant_n is controlled by this register., 0x0: set BCA coex grant bt_grant_n to zero, 0x1: set BCA coex grant bt_grant_n to one

field.name: clralltxcntrs
field.description: Clear All Tx Counters, When set; all of the PTA diagnostic counters are reset to 0:, - Tx_Req_Hi_Cnt, - Tx_Loss_Hi_Cnt, - Tx_Loss_Med_Cnt, - Tx_Req_Med_Cnt, - Tx_Req_Med_Hi; Cnt, - Tx_Loss_Med_Hi_Cnt, 0x0: do not clear counters, 0x1: clear counters

field.name: mrvlcoexexiten
field.description: Marvell Coexistence Exit Enable, Enable the reset of the MRVL coexistence state machine if neither rifTx nor rifRx is active at frameTick such that BT_REQ will go low., 0x0: disable, 0x1: enable

field.name: pta_req_delay
field.description: PTA Request Delay, When BTU uses MRVL Coexistence mode; this controls the delay from pta_tx_req/pta_rx_req to the rising edge of the BT_REQ., This value should never be programmed more than 15us; otherwise unexpected behavior will occur; such as dropped packets due to BCA grant timeout., - Unit: 0.25 us.

register.name: btu_pta_ble_rif_arb_coex_pri
register.description: BLE PTA Priority for BTC/BLE arbitration, BLE coex priority for BTC/BLE arbitration.

field.name: ble_tx_pri
field.description: BLE Coex Priority, The BLE Tx packet high/medium priority that is used to make RIF_ARB arbitration request.

field.name: ble_rx_pri
field.description: BLE Coex Priority, The BLE Rx packet high/medium priority that is used to make RIF_ARB arbitration request.

register.name: btu_pta_ble_bca_coex_pri
register.description: BLE PTA Priority for BCA arbitration, BLE coex priority for BCA arbitration.

field.name: ble_tx_pri
field.description: BLE Coex Priority, The BLE Tx packet high/medium priority that is used to make BCA request.

field.name: ble_rx_pri
field.description: BLE Coex Priority, The BLE Rx packet high/medium priority that is used to make BCA request.

register.name: btu_pta_inband_freq_set_1
register.description: PTA Inband Frequency Set 0, BT_FREQ is set when (BT_In_Band_Hi >= freqNr >= BT_In_Band_Lo) in MRVL Coexistence mode and BT_In_Band1_Freq_En is enabled. 2 sets of band gaps; final BT_FREQ is OR version of 2 sets.

field.name: bt_in_band_lo
field.description: Bluetooth In Band Low, In MRVL Coexistence mode; this is the low bound of the frequency channel for BT_FREQ.

field.name: bt_in_band_hi
field.description: Bluetooth In Band High, In MRVL Coexistence mode; this is the high bound of the frequency channel for BT_FREQ.

field.name: bt_coex_mode
field.description: Bluetooth Coexistence Mode Select, 0x0: disable, 0x1: CSR mode, 0x2: MRVL mode, 0x3: SUSHI mode

field.name: bt_mws_coex_en
field.description: Bluetooth and MWS Coexistence Mode Enable

field.name: bt_ovlp_mode
field.description: Bluetooth Overlap Mode, Select bt_overlap assertion mode, 0x0: non-filtered; old design, 0x1: filtered mode

field.name: ovlp_supress_en
field.description: Overlap Suppression Enable, Suppress BT_Overlap/BT_Scan_Overlap assertion if Tx power is less than the programmed threshold., 0x0: disable, 0x1: enable, BT_Overlap/BT_Scan_Overlap assertion to BCA will be suppressed if Tx_Power_Index, Value is less than the programmed BTU_PTA_TX_POWER_THRESHOLD for BR/EDR packet, type or is less than BTU_PTA_BLE_TX_PWR_THRHD for BLE packet.

field.name: bt_scan_ovlp_mode
field.description: Bluetooth Scan Overlap Mode, Select bt_scan_overlap assertion mode, 0x0: non-filtered; old design, 0x1: filtered mode

field.name: bt_scan_ovlp_rx_en
field.description: Scan Overlap for Bluetooth Rx, Enables bt_scan_overlap assertion for Bluetooth Rx., 0x0: disable, 0x1: enable

field.name: bt_tx_on_mode
field.description: BT_TX_ON mode selection, Selects the mode of operation for asserting the BT_TX_ON signal., - Bit[15]: Direct Mode: BT_TX_ON signal assertion is independent of MWS Rx and MWS scan operations, - Bit[14]: Filtered Mode: BT_TX_ON signal is asserted in real time by hardware by taking into account of MWS Rx overlap and MWS scan overlap conditions

register.name: btu_pta_inband_freq_set_0
register.description: PTA Inband Frequency Set 1, BT_FREQ is set when (BT_In_Band_Hi >= freqNr >= BT_In_Band_Lo) in MRVL Coexistence mode. 2 sets of band gaps; final BT_FREQ is OR version of 2 sets.

field.name: bt_in_band_lo
field.description: Bluetooth In Band Low, In MRVL Coexistence mode; this is the low bound of the frequency channel for BT_FREQ.

field.name: bt_in_band_hi
field.description: Bluetooth In Band High, In MRVL Coexistence mode; this is the high bound of the frequency channel for BT_FREQ.

field.name: harqpatternselreg
field.description: MWS Coex Signal HARQ_PATTERN_SEL Value, Contains the new HARQ_PATTERN_SEL value being received. When new HARQ_PATTERN_SEL is detected; the HARQ_Pattern_Sel_Real_Int real-time interrupt will be generated and new value of HARQ_PATTERN_SEL will be saved in here.

field.name: mwsinactmsgreg
field.description: MWS Coex Signal MWS_INACT_MSG Value, Contains the new MWS_INACT_MSG value being received. When new MWS_INACT_MSG is detected; the MWS_Inact_Msg_Real_Int real-time interrupt will be generated and new value of MWS_INACT_MSG will be saved here.

field.name: pta_info_delay
field.description: Bluetooth Sniff Interval, When BT_Coex_Mode is set to MRVL mode; this is the time transition time for each of the PTA info bits (i.e.; priority bits) that are serially encoded on BT_STATE line., A value of 0 is invalid; and will lead to unknown results., - Unit: 0.25 us

field.name: ble_sync_priority
field.description: BLE Sync Priority, Sets Priority (sync_priority) for sync frame. The bt_state encodes if the current request is a sync frame or a regular frame. Each frame also has a 2-bit priority. BLE firmware sync_priority value if BLE controls the radio.

field.name: ble_sync_dir
field.description: BLE Sync Direction, Controls the direction of the sync frame (sync_dir). BLE firmware sync_dir value if BLE controls the radio., 0x0: Rx first, 0x1: Tx first

field.name: ble_sync_frame_fw_val
field.description: BLE Sync Frame Firmware Value, BLE firmware sync_frame value if BLE controls the radio.

field.name: ble_sync_frame_extend
field.description: BLE Sync Frame Extend, BLE firmware sync_frame value will be extended (kept asserted) if BLE keeps controlling the radio. However; sync_frame value will be reset if BLE ongoing event got cutoff or abort., 0x0: sync_frame value will be de-asserted at falling edge of bt_req, 0x1: sync_frame value will be extended

register.name: btu_pta_pri_inc_ebram_addr
register.description: EBRAM Base Address: PTA Priority Escalation

field.name: sync_mode_en
field.description: Sync Mode Enable, Enable MRVL Coexistence syncModel mode. The BT_STATE encodes if the current request is a sync frame or a regular frame. Each frame also has a 2-bit sync frame priority and a sync frame direction bit., If MRVL Coexistence syncModel mode is on; 4 more sync frame coexistence info are encoded sequentially on BT_STATE before other coexistence info:, 1. Sync Frame (sync_frame), 2. Sync Priority[0] (sync_priority[0]), 3. Sync Priority[1] (sync_priority[1]), 4. Sync Direction (sync_dir)

register.name: btu_pta_ble_tx_pwr_thrhd
register.description: BLE Tx Power Threshold to Suppress Tx Overlap Assertion

field.name: ble1m_tx_pwr_thrshld
field.description: BLE Tx power threshold for 1 Mbps packet to suppress BT_Overlap/BT_Scan_Overlap assertion

field.name: ble2m_tx_pwr_thrshld
field.description: BLE Tx power threshold for 2 Mbps packet to suppress BT_Overlap/BT_Scan_Overlap assertion

field.name: pta_state_delay
field.description: PTA State Delay, When BT_Coex_Mode is in MRVL mode; this controls the delay for the BT_STATE transition for the second transaction., This value should never be programmed less than 15us; otherwise unexpected behavior will occur; such as dropped packets., - Unit: 0.25 us.

field.name: ble_use_slna
field.description: BLE uses SLNA based on RSSI info, Among all Bluetooth link RSSI average information; software decides which path BLE traffic will use for Rx; for example; SLNA or path 3 of Bluetooth only., 0x0: use path 3 for Bluetooth only based on BLE RSSI average, 0x1: enable SLNA path based on BLE RSSI average

field.name: ble_slna_cp_en_bp_sel
field.description: BLE side enable SLNA bias/charge pump bypass for software control, By default; slna_cp_en is dynamically control by rifRx because it requires 120us in advance. However; software can bypass it to control this enable by ble_slna_cp_en_bp_val with this selection bit is set., 0x0: use hardware dynamically controlled SLNA_cp_en, 0x1: software bypass to control the SLNA_cp_en

field.name: ble_slna_cp_en_bp_val
field.description: SLNA_cp Enable, When ble_slna_cp_en_by_sel is set; this value controls if SLNA_cp is enabled., When ble_slna_cp_en_by_sel is set; software controls SLNA_cp_en to enable or disable by this bit., 0x0: eisable SLNA cp, 0x1: enable SLNA cp

register.name: btu_pta_tx_power_threshold
register.description: Tx Power Threshold to Suppress Tx Overlap Assertion

field.name: bdr_tx_pwr_thrshld
field.description: Tx power threshold for BDR packet to suppress bt_overlap/bt_scan_overlap assertion

field.name: edr_tx_pwr_thrshld
field.description: Tx power threshold for EDR packet to suppress bt_overlap/bt_scan_overlap assertion

register.name: btu_pta_mws_tx_overlap_range
register.description: MWS Frequency Overlap Range for Bluetooth Tx Slot

field.name: tx_mws_overlap_range
field.description: MWS frequency overlap range for BR/EDR Tx Slots, Under MWS Coex Mode; MWS frequency overlap range for BR/EDR Tx slots., Bit[7] direction bit:, - Bits[6:0] value: overlap boundary channel, The overlap boundary indexes the Bluetooth's 0~78 channels. The direction bit being 0 represents the upper boundary channel and all smaller index channels thereof are fallen in the overlap range; whereas the bit begin 1 represents the lower boundary channel and all larger index channels thereof are fallen in the overlap range., 0x0: upper boundary, 0x1: lower boundary

field.name: ble_tx_mws_overlap_range
field.description: MWS frequency overlap range for BLE Tx packets, Under MWS Coex Mode; MWS frequency overlap range for BLE Tx packets., Bit[7] direction bit:, - Bits[6:0] value: overlap boundary channel, The overlap boundary indexes the Bluetooth's 0~78 channels. The direction bit being 0 represents the upper boundary channel and all smaller index channels thereof are fallen in the overlap range; whereas the bit begin 1 represents the lower boundary channel and all larger index channels thereof are fallen in the overlap range., 0x0: upper boundary, 0x1: lower boundary

register.name: btu_pta_mws_rx_overlap_range
register.description: MWS Frequency Overlap Range for Bluetooth Rx Slot

field.name: rx_mws_overlap_range
field.description: MWS frequency overlap range for BR/EDR Rx Slots, Under MWS Coex Mode; MWS frequency overlap range for BR/EDR Rx slots., Bit[7] direction bit:, - Bits[6:0] value: overlap boundary, The overlap boundary indexes the Bluetooth's 0~78 channels. The direction bit being '0' represents the upper boundary channel and all smaller index channels thereof are fallen in the overlap range; whereas the bit begin '1' represents the lower boundary channel and all larger index channels thereof are fallen in the overlap range., 0x0: upper boundary, 0x1: lower boundary

field.name: ble_rx_mws_overlap_range
field.description: MWS frequency overlap range for BLE Rx Packets, Under MWS Coex Mode; MWS frequency overlap range for BLE Rx packets., Bit[7] direction bit:, - Bits[6:0] value: overlap boundary, The overlap boundary indexes the Bluetooth's 0~78 channels. The direction bit being '0' represents the upper boundary channel and all smaller index channels thereof are fallen in the overlap range; whereas the bit begin '1' represents the lower boundary channel and all larger index channels thereof are fallen in the overlap range., 0x0: upper boundary, 0x1: lower boundary

register.name: btu_pta_mws_coex_bt_tx_on_start
register.description: MWS Coex Signal BT_TX_ON Start Timer

field.name: bttxonstartreg
field.description: BT_TX_ON Start Timer, Under MWS Coex Mode; btTxOnStartReg determines the delay from rifTx assertion to the rising edge of BT_TX_ON. The time between the rising edge of BT_TX_ON to the rifTx assertion is (btTxOnStartReg+1) unit of 0.25us., This value should never be program less than 1; other wise unexpected behavior will occur., - Resolution: 0.25 us., Since this signal can only assert on successful grant from BCA; this timing needs to be greater than the delay from rifTx to bca_grant_n.

register.name: btu_pta_mws_coex_bt_tx_on_end
register.description: MWS Coex Signal BT_TX_ON End Timer

field.name: bttxonendreg
field.description: BT_TX_ON End Timer, Under MWS Coex Mode; btTxOnEndReg determines the delay from rifTx de-assertion to the falling edge of BT_TX_ON. The time between the falling edge of BT_TX_ON to the rifTx de-assertion is (btTxOnEndReg+1) unit of 0.25us., This value should never be program less than 1; otherwise unexpected behavior will occur., - Resolution: 0.25 us.

register.name: btu_pta_mws_coex_bt_rx_pri_start_mst
register.description: MWS Coex Signal BT_RX_PRI Start Timer for Master Mode

field.name: btrxpristartmstreg
field.description: BT_RX_PRI Start Timer for Master Mode, In Real Time mode; btRxPriStartMstReg determines the delay from rifRx (if bt_rx_pri_mst_tm_sel/bt_rx_pri_page_resp_tm_sel/bt_rx_pri_inq_resp_tm_sel = 0) or rifTx (if bt_rx_pri_mst_tm_sel/bt_rx_pri_page_resp_tm_sel/bt_rx_pri_inq_resp_tm_sel = 1) assertion to the rising edge of BT_RX_PRI. The time between the rising edge of BT_RX_PRI to the rifRx (or rifTx) assertion is (btRxPriStartMstReg+1) unit of 0.25us., This value should never be program less than 1; other wise unexpected behavior will occur., - Resolution: 0.25 us., Since this signal can only assert on successful grant from BCA; this timing needs to be greater than the delay from rifRx (or rifTx) to bca_grant_n.

register.name: btu_pta_mws_coex_bt_rx_pri_end
register.description: MWS Coex Signal BT_RX_PRI End Timer

field.name: btrxpriendreg
field.description: BT_RX_PRI End Timer, Under MWS Coex Mode; btRxPriEndReg determines the delay from rifRx de-assertion to the falling edge of BT_RX_PRI The time between the falling edge of BT_RX_PRI to the rifRx de-assertion is (btRxPriEndReg+1) unit of 0.25us., This value should never be program less than 1; otherwise unexpected behavior will occur., - Resolution: 0.25 us.

field.name: mws_scan_ovlp_range_1
field.description: MWS scan frequency overlap range 1, The MWS scan frequency overlap range 1 register is indexed by MWS_SCAN_FREQUENCY[4:0] = 'b0_0001 during MWS scan operation., - Bit[3] indicates the direction: 0 = represents the upper boundary; the number of subgroups being overlapped counts forward from subgroup 0. 1 = represents the lower boundary; the number of subgroups being overlapped counts backward from subgroup 7. Bits[2:0] indicate the number of Bluetooth channel subgroups that fall into the overlap range., - Pre-defined encoding: 0000: no overlapped. 1000: all channel 0~78 overlapped. 0001: channel 0~9 are overlapped with lower MWS scan frequency band; channel 10~78 are not. 0010: channel 0~19 are overlapped with lower MWS scan frequency band; channel 20~78 are not. ... 1001: channel 70~78 are overlapped with upper MWS scan frequency band; channel 0~69 are not. 1010: channel 60~78 are overlapped with upper MWS scan frequency band; channel 0~59 are not. ...

field.name: bt_rx_pri_mode
field.description: BT_RX_PRI mode selection, These select the mode of operation for asserting the BT_RX_PRI signal., Bit[1] selects the Advance Mode. BT_RX_PRI signal assertion is based on earlyBtRxPri bit in Frame Descriptor programmed by firmware., Bit[0] selects the Real Time Mode. BT_RX_PRI signal is asserted in real time by hardware based on Bluetooth Rx packet's priority and event types.

field.name: bt_rx_pri_page_resp_mst
field.description: BT_RX_PRI assertion during page response at master side, This bit enables BT_RX_PRI assertion by BTU for critical Rx during page response at master side.

field.name: bt_rx_pri_inq_resp
field.description: BT_RX_PRI assertion during inquiry response, This bit enables BT_RX_PRI assertion by BTU for critical Rx during inquiry response.

field.name: bt_rx_pri_page_resp_slv
field.description: BT_RX_PRI assertion during page response at slave side, This bit enables BT_RX_PRI assertion by BTU for critical Rx during page response at slave side.

field.name: bt_rx_pri_mst_tm_sel
field.description: BT_RX_PRI advance timing selection in Real Time mode for Bluetooth master mode, select 100us or 600us range advance timing., 0x0: select 100us range (BT_RX_PRI assertion is delayed by, BTU_PTA_MWS_COEX_BT_RX_PRI_START_MST from rifRx rising edge of the Rx packet), 0x1: select 600us range (BT_RX_PRI assertion is delayed by, BTU_PTA_MWS_COEX_BT_RX_PRI_START_MST from rifTx rising edge of the preceding Tx, packet)

field.name: bt_rx_pri_page_resp_tm_sel
field.description: BT_RX_PRI advance timing selection during master or slave page response, select 100us or 600us range advance timing, 0x0: select 100us range. For master; BT_RX_PRI assertion is delayed by, BTU_PTA_MWS_COEX_BT_RX_PRI_START_MST from rifRx rising edge of each Rx ID, packet. For slave; BT_RX_PRI assertion is delayed by, BTU_PTA_MWS_COEX_BT_RX_PRI_START_SLV from rifRx rising edge of the Rx FHS, packet., 0x1: select 600us range. For master; BT_RX_PRI assertion is delayed by, BTU_PTA_MWS_COEX_BT_RX_PRI_START_MST from rifTx rising edge of the first Tx ID, packet. For slave; BT_RX_PRI assertion is delayed by, BTU_PTA_MWS_COEX_BT_RX_PRI_START_SLV from correlation hit of the first or second, Rx ID packet.

field.name: bt_rx_pri_inq_resp_tm_sel
field.description: BT_RX_PRI advance timing selection during inquiry response, select 100us or 600us range advance timing, 0x0: select 100us range. BT_RX_PRI assertion is delayed by, BTU_PTA_MWS_COEX_BT_RX_PRI_START_MST from rifRx rising edge of the FHS packet., 0x1: select 600us range. BT_RX_PRI assertion is delayed by, BTU_PTA_MWS_COEX_BT_RX_PRI_START_MST from rifTx rising edge of the first Tx ID, packet.

field.name: early_bt_rx_pri_deass_fram_cnt
field.description: Number of frames BT_RX_PRI should be de-asserted, This frame counter register is used to track how many frames in advance firmware is programming. When the earlyBtRxPri bit in frame descriptor is set; hardware will load this register value into hardware counter. BTU will de-assert BT_RX_PRI with appropriate timing on the frame that this hardware counter decrements to zero. This way firmware only will program earlyBtRxPri frame bit once for one packet.

field.name: bt_rx_pri_drive
field.description: Control BT_RX_PRI logic level directly, This bit allows firmware to control the outgoing BT_RX_PRI logic level directly in real time.

field.name: bt_rx_pri_assrt_lvl
field.description: Specify priority level to assert BT_RX_PRI for BR/EDR packet, Only the coex_priority with the same or higher level than this setting will cause the assertion of BT_RX_PRI to BCA.

field.name: ble_rx_pri_assrt_lvl
field.description: Specify priority level to assert BT_RX_PRI for BLE packet, Only the coex_priority with the same or higher level than this setting will cause the assertion of BT_RX_PRI to BCA.

register.name: btu_pta_mws_early_bt_rx_pri_staroffst_mst
register.description: MWS Coex Early BT_RX_PRI Start Offset for Master Mode

field.name: startoffsetmst
field.description: Start Offset in Master Mode, Early indication BT_RX_PRI assertion time offset in Advance mode of MWS Coex when operating in master mode. Time unit is 0.25us. When the earlyBtRxPri bit in frame descriptor is set in master mode; hardware will assert BT_RX_PRI at (earlyBtRxPriStartOffsetMst * 0.25) us after the start of frame. The valid range is 0x2 ~ 0x1387 (1250us).

register.name: btu_pta_mws_early_bt_rx_pri_staroffst_slv
register.description: MWS Coex Early BT_RX_PRI Start Offset for Slave Mode

field.name: startoffsetslv
field.description: Start Offset in Slave Mode, Early indication BT_RX_PRI assertion time offset in Advance mode of MWS Coex when operating in slave mode. Time unit is 0.25us. When the earlyBtRxPri bit in frame descriptor is set in slave mode; hardware will assert BT_RX_PRI at (earlyBtRxPriStartOffsetSlv * 0.25) us after the start of frame. The valid range is 0x2 ~ 0x1387 (1250us).

register.name: btu_pta_mws_coex_bt_rx_pri_start_slv
register.description: MWS Coex Signal BT_RX_PRI Start Timer for Slave Mode

field.name: btrxpristartslvreg
field.description: BT_RX_PRI Start Timer for Slave Mode, In Real Time mode; btRxPriStartSlvReg determines the delay from rifRx assertion (or correlation hit if bt_rx_pri_page_resp_tm_sel = 1) to the rising edge of BT_RX_PRI. The time between the rising edge of BT_RX_PRI to the rifRx assertion is (btRxPriStartSlvReg+1) unit of 0.25us., This value should never be program less than 1; other wise unexpected behavior will occur., - Resolution: 0.25 us., Since this signal can only assert on successful grant from BCA; this timing needs to be greater than the delay from rifRx to bca_grant_n.

field.name: bca_ant_switch_sts_bypass_en

field.name: bca_ant_switch_sts_bypass_val

field.name: bca_ref_antenna_override

enumeratedValue.name: CK_0
enumeratedValue.description: Normal configuration. When NBU CPU executes WFI and SLEEP_EN=1 (or if NBU CPU reset is asserted), and a sleep request from RFMC (LP_ENTER) NBU, MAN or WOR is asserted, the flash is put in low power, the sleep_rdy to RFMC asserts and the FRO will be disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: CK_1
enumeratedValue.description: Configuration where NBU, FRO and flash are not used. When NBU CPU reset is asserted, or NBU CPU executes WFI and SLEEP_EN=1, the flash will be placed in low power, the FRO disabled, the sleep_rdy to RFMC will assert and the NBU CM3 and AHB clocks will be gated off. The RF_CMC and NBU CPU will be without a clock until the next reset, but low power requests (RFMC LP_ENTER, MAN or WOR) will by accepted by RFMC since RF_CMC's sleep_rdy output will remain asserted.

enumeratedValue.name: CK_2
enumeratedValue.description: Configuration where NBU CPU is not used but FRO and flash can still be used. When NBU CPU reset is asserted, or NBU CPU executes WFI and SLEEP_EN=1, the clock to the NBU CPU will be gated. When RFMC (LP_ENTER), MAN or WOR request sleep, the flash is put in low power, the sleep_rdy to RFMC asserts and the FRO will be disabled as in configuration 00.

field.name: STIMENA
field.description: For bit STIMENA[n], in register ITM_TERx: 0 = Stimulus port (32x + n) disabled 1 = Stimulus port (32x + n) enabled

field.name: PRIVMASK
field.description: Bit mask to enable tracing on ITM stimulus ports: Bit [0] = stimulus port [7:0] Bit [1] = stimulus port [15:8] Bit [2] = stimulus port [23:16] Bit [3] = stimulus port [31:24]

enumeratedValue.name: ITMENA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ITMENA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: TSENA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: TSENA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: SYNCENA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: SYNCENA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: TXENA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: TXENA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled.

enumeratedValue.name: SWOENA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp counter uses the processor system clock.

enumeratedValue.name: SWOENA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Timestamp counter uses asynchronous clock from the TPIU interface.

field.name: TSPrescale
field.description: Local timestamp prescaler, used with the trace packet reference clock.

enumeratedValue.name: TSPrescale_0
enumeratedValue.description: No prescaling.

enumeratedValue.name: TSPrescale_1
enumeratedValue.description: Divide by 4.

enumeratedValue.name: TSPrescale_2
enumeratedValue.description: Divide by 16.

enumeratedValue.name: TSPrescale_3
enumeratedValue.description: Divide by 64.

field.name: GTSFREQ
field.description: Global timestamp frequency. Defines how often the ITM generates a global timestamp, based on the global timestamp clock frequency, or disables generation of global timestamps.

enumeratedValue.name: GTSFREQ_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disable generation of global timestamps.

enumeratedValue.name: GTSFREQ_1
enumeratedValue.description: Generate timestamp request whenever the ITM detects a change in global timestamp counter bits [47:7]. This is approximately every 128 cycles.

enumeratedValue.name: GTSFREQ_2
enumeratedValue.description: Generate timestamp request whenever the ITM detects a change in global timestamp counter bits [47:13]. This is approximately every 8192 cycles.

enumeratedValue.name: GTSFREQ_3
enumeratedValue.description: Generate a timestamp after every packet, if the output FIFO is empty.

field.name: TraceBusID
field.description: Identifier for multi-source trace stream formatting. If multi-source trace is in use, the debugger must write a non-zero value to this field.

field.name: BUSY
field.description: Indicates whether the ITM is currently processing events: 0: ITM is not processing any events. 1: ITM events present and being drained.

enumeratedValue.name: BUSY_0
enumeratedValue.description: ITM is not processing any events.

enumeratedValue.name: BUSY_1
enumeratedValue.description: ITM events present and beeing drained.

field.name: WriteAccessCode
field.description: Write Access Code. A write of 0xC5ACCE55 enables further write access to this device. An invalid write will have the affect of removing write access.

field.name: IMP
field.description: Lock mechanism is implemented. This bit always reads 1.

field.name: STATUS
field.description: Lock Status. This bit is HIGH when the device is locked, and LOW when unlocked.

field.name: s8BIT
field.description: Access Lock Register size. This bit reads 0 to indicate a 32-bit register is present.

enumeratedValue.name: ComponentClass_1
enumeratedValue.description: ROM table.

enumeratedValue.name: ComponentClass_9
enumeratedValue.description: CoreSight component.

enumeratedValue.name: ComponentClass_15
enumeratedValue.description: PrimeCell of system component with no standardized register layout, for backward compatibility.

peripheral.name: DWT
peripheral.description: Data Watchpoint and Trace Unit Registers

field.name: CYCCNTENA
field.description: CYCCNTENA bit. Enables CYCCNT. This bit is UNK/SBZP if the NOCYCCNT bit is RAO.

enumeratedValue.name: CYCCNTENA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: CYCCNTENA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled.

field.name: POSTPRESET
field.description: POSTPRESET bits. Reload value for the POSTCNT counter. This field is UNK/SBZP if the NOCYCCNT bit is RAO.

field.name: POSTINIT
field.description: POSTINIT bits. Initial value for the POSTCNT counter. This field is UNK/SBZP if the NOCYCCNT bit is RAO.

field.name: CYCTAP
field.description: CYCTAP bit. Selects the position of the POSTCNT tap on the CYCCNT counter. This bit is UNK/SBZP if the NOCYCCNT bit is RAO.

enumeratedValue.name: CYCTAP_0
enumeratedValue.description: POSTCNT tap at CYCCNT[6].

enumeratedValue.name: CYCTAP_1
enumeratedValue.description: POSTCNT tap at CYCCNT[10].

field.name: SYNCTAP
field.description: SYNCTAP bits. Selects the position of the synchronization packet counter tap on the CYCCNT counter. This determines the Synchronization packet rate.

enumeratedValue.name: SYNCTAP_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled. No Synchronization packets.

enumeratedValue.name: SYNCTAP_1
enumeratedValue.description: Synchronization counter tap at CYCCNT[24].

enumeratedValue.name: SYNCTAP_2
enumeratedValue.description: Synchronization counter tap at CYCCNT[26].

enumeratedValue.name: SYNCTAP_3
enumeratedValue.description: Synchronization counter tap at CYCCNT[28].

field.name: PCSAMPLENA
field.description: PCSAMPLENA bit. Enables use of POSTCNT counter as a timer for Periodic PC sample packet generation. This bit is UNK/SBZP if the NOTRCPKT bit is RAO or the NOCYCCNT bit is RAO.

enumeratedValue.name: PCSAMPLENA_0
enumeratedValue.description: No Periodic PC sample packets generated.

enumeratedValue.name: PCSAMPLENA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Periodic PC sample packets generated.

field.name: EXCTRCENA
field.description: EXCTRCENA bit. Enables generation of exception trace. This bit is UNK/SBZP if the NOTRCPKT bit is RAO.

enumeratedValue.name: EXCTRCENA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: EXCTRCENA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled.

field.name: CPIEVTENA
field.description: CPIEVTENA bit. Enables generation of the CPI counter overflow event. This bit is UNK/SBZP if the NOPRFCNT bit is RAO.

enumeratedValue.name: CPIEVTENA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: CPIEVTENA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled.

field.name: EXCEVTENA
field.description: EXCEVTENA bit. Enables generation of the Exception overhead counter overflow event. This bit is UNK/SBZP if the NOPRFCNT bit is RAO.

enumeratedValue.name: EXCEVTENA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: EXCEVTENA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled.

field.name: SLEEPEVTENA
field.description: SLEEPEVTENA bit. Enables generation of the Sleep counter overflow event. This bit is UNK/SBZP if the NOPRFCNT bit is RAO.

enumeratedValue.name: SLEEPEVTENA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: SLEEPEVTENA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled.

field.name: LSUEVTENA
field.description: LSUEVTENA bit. Enables generation of the LSU counter overflow event. This bit is UNK/SBZP if the NOPRFCNT bit is RAO.

enumeratedValue.name: LSUEVTENA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: LSUEVTENA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled.

field.name: FOLDEVTENA
field.description: FOLDEVTENA bit. Enables generation of the Folded-instruction counter overflow event. This bit is UNK/SBZP if the NOPRFCNT bit is RAO.

enumeratedValue.name: FOLDEVTENA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: FOLDEVTENA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled.

field.name: CYCEVTENA
field.description: CYCEVTENA bit. Enables POSTCNT underflow Event counter packets generation. This bit is UNK/SBZP if the NOTRCPKT bit is RAO or the NOCYCCNT bit is RAO.

enumeratedValue.name: CYCEVTENA_0
enumeratedValue.description: No POSTCNT underflow packets generated.

enumeratedValue.name: CYCEVTENA_1
enumeratedValue.description: POSTCNT underflow packets generated, if PCSAMPLENA set to 0.

field.name: NOPFRCNT
field.description: NOPFRCNT bit. Shows whether the implementation supports the profiling counters.

enumeratedValue.name: NOPFRCNT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Supported.

enumeratedValue.name: NOPFRCNT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Not supported.

field.name: NOCYCCNT
field.description: NOCYCCNT bit. Shows whether the implementation supports a cycle counter.

enumeratedValue.name: NOCYCCNT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Cycle counter supported.

enumeratedValue.name: NOCYCCNT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Cycle counter not supported.

field.name: NOEXTTRIG
field.description: NOEXTRRIG bit. Shows whether the implementation includes external match signals, CMPMATCH[N].

enumeratedValue.name: NOEXTTRIG_0
enumeratedValue.description: CMPMATCH[N] supported.

enumeratedValue.name: NOEXTTRIG_1
enumeratedValue.description: CMPMATCH[N] not supported.

field.name: NOTRCPKT
field.description: NOTRCPKT bit. Shows whether the implementation supports trace sampling and exception tracing. If this bit is RAZ, the NOCYCCNT bit must also RAZ.

enumeratedValue.name: NOTRCPKT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Trace sampling and exception tracing supported.

enumeratedValue.name: NOTRCPKT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Trace sampling and exception tracing not supported.

field.name: NUMCOMP
field.description: NUMCOMP bits. Number of comparators implemented. A value of zero indicates no comparator support.

field.name: CYCCNT
field.description: CYCCNT[31:0]. Incrementing cycle counter value. When enabled, CYCCNT increments on each processor clock cycle. On overflow, CYCCNT wraps to zero.

field.name: CPICNT
field.description: CPICNT[7:0]. The base CPI counter. Counts additional cycles required to execute multi-cycle instructions, except those recorded by DWT_LSUCNT, and counts any instruction fetch stalls.

field.name: EXCCNT
field.description: EXCCNT[7:0]. The exception overhead counter. Counts the total cycles spent in exception processing.

field.name: SLEEPCNT
field.description: SLEEPCNT[7:0]. Sleep counter. Counts the total number of cycles that the processor is sleeping.

field.name: LSUCNT
field.description: LSUCNT[7:0]. Load-store counter. Increments on any additional cycles required to execute load or store instructions.

field.name: FOLDCNT
field.description: FOLDCNT[7:0]. Folded-instruction counter. Increments on each instruction that takes 0 cycles.

field.name: EIASAMPLE
field.description: EIASAMPLE[31:0]. Executed Instruction Address sample value.

field.name: MASK
field.description: MASK[4:0]. The size of the ignore mask, 0-31 bits, applied to address range matching. The maximum mask size is IMPLEMENTATION DEFINED. A debugger can write 0b11111 to this field and then read the register back to determine the maximum mask size supported.

field.name: FUNCTION
field.description: FUNCTION[3:0]. Selects action taken on comparator match. This field resets to zero.

field.name: EMITRANGE
field.description: EMITRANGE bit. If the implementation supports trace sampling, enables generation of Data trace address offset packets, that hold Daddr[15:0]. If DWT_CTRL.NOTRCPKT is RAZ then this bit is UNK/SBZP.

enumeratedValue.name: EMITRANGE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Data trace address offset packets disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: EMITRANGE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enable Data trace address offset packet generation.

field.name: CYCMATCH
field.description: CYCMATCH bit. If the implementation supports cycle counting, enable cycle count comparison for comparator 0. If DWT_CTRL.NOCYCCNT is RAZ then this bit is UNK/SBZP.

enumeratedValue.name: CYCMATCH_0
enumeratedValue.description: No comparison is performed.

enumeratedValue.name: CYCMATCH_1
enumeratedValue.description: Compare DWT_COMP0 with the cycle counter, DWT_CYCCNT.

field.name: DATAVMATCH
field.description: DATAVMATCH bit. Enables data value comparison, if supported. For comparator 0, when the CYCMATCH is set to 1, DATAVMATCH must be set to 0 for it to perform cycle count comparison. See LNK1ENA, DATAVSIZE, DATAVADDR0 and DATAVADDR1 for related information. If the implementation does not support data value comparison this bit is RAZ/WI.

enumeratedValue.name: DATAVMATCH_0
enumeratedValue.description: Perform address comparison.

enumeratedValue.name: DATAVMATCH_1
enumeratedValue.description: Perform data value comparison.

field.name: LNK1ENA
field.description: LNK1ENA bit. Indicates whether the implementation supports use of a second linked comparator. When LNK1ENA is RAO, the DATAVADDR1 field specifies the comparator to use as the second linked comparator.

enumeratedValue.name: LNK1ENA_0
enumeratedValue.description: Second linked comparator not supported.

enumeratedValue.name: LNK1ENA_1
enumeratedValue.description: Second linked comparator supported.

field.name: DATAVSIZE
field.description: DATAVSIZE[1:0]. For data value matching, specifies the size of the required data comparison.

enumeratedValue.name: DATAVSIZE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Byte.

enumeratedValue.name: DATAVSIZE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Halfword.

enumeratedValue.name: DATAVSIZE_2
enumeratedValue.description: Word.

field.description: DATAVADDR0[3:0]. When the DATAVMATCH bit is set to 1 this field can hold the comparator number of a comparator to use for linked address comparison. The DWT unit ignores the value of this field if the DATAVMATCH bit is set to 0.

field.name: DATAVADDR1

enumeratedValue.description: Match.

peripheral.name: FPB
peripheral.description: Flash Patch and Breakpoint Unit Registers

field.name: ENABLE
field.description: Enable bit for the FPB. A Power-on reset clears this bit to 0.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE_0
enumeratedValue.description: FPB disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE_1
enumeratedValue.description: FPB enabled.

field.name: KEY
field.description: KEY bit. On any write to FP_CTRL, the FPB unit ignores the write unless this bit is 1. This bit is RAZ.

field.name: NUM_CODE_least
field.description: NUM_CODE[3:0]. The least significant bits of NUM_CODE, the number of instruction address comparators. If NUM_CODE[6:0] is zero, the implementation does not support any instruction address comparators.

field.name: NUM_LIT
field.description: NUM_LIT bits. The number of literal address comparators supported. If this field is zero, the implementation does not support literal comparators.

field.name: NUM_CODE_most
field.description: NUM_CODE[6:4]. The most significant bits of NUM_CODE, the number of instruction address comparators, see bits [7:4].

field.name: REMAP
field.description: REMAP bits. If the FPB supports flash patch remap, this field: - holds bits [28:5] of the base address in SRAM to which the FPB remaps the address - has an UNKNOWN value on reset. If the FPB only supports breakpoint functionality this field is UNK/SBZP.

field.name: RMPSPT
field.description: RMPSPT bit. Indicates whether the FPB unit supports flash patch remap.

enumeratedValue.name: RMPSPT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Remapping not supported. The FPB only supports breakpoint functionality.

enumeratedValue.name: RMPSPT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Hard-wired remap to SRAM region.

field.name: ENABLE
field.description: Enable bit for this comparator. A Power-on reset clears this bit to 0.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Comparator disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Comparator enabled.

field.name: COMP
field.description: COMP bits. Bits [28:2] of the address to compare with addresses from the Code memory region. Bits [31:29] and [1:0] of the address for comparison are zero. If a match occurs: - for an instruction address comparator, the REPLACE field defines the required action - for a literal address comparator, the FPB remaps the access. The reset value of this field is UNKNOWN.

field.name: REPLACE
field.description: REPLACE[1:0]. For an instruction address comparator: - Defines the behavior when the COMP address is matched. - The reset value of this field is UNKNOWN. For a literal address comparator: - Field is UNK/SBZP.

enumeratedValue.name: REPLACE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Remap to remap address.

enumeratedValue.name: REPLACE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Breakpoint on lower halfword, upper is unaffected.

enumeratedValue.name: REPLACE_2
enumeratedValue.description: Breakpoint on upper halfword, lower is unaffected.

enumeratedValue.name: REPLACE_3
enumeratedValue.description: Breakpoint on both lower and upper halfwords.

If a match occurs: - for an instruction address comparator, the REPLACE field defines the required action - for a literal address comparator, the FPB remaps the access. The reset value of this field is UNKNOWN.

field.name: REPLACE
field.description: REPLACE[1:0]. For an instruction address comparator: - Defines the behavior when the COMP address is matched. - The reset value of this field is UNKNOWN. For a literal address comparator: - Field is UNK/SBZP.

enumeratedValue.name: REPLACE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Remap to remap address.

enumeratedValue.name: REPLACE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Breakpoint on lower halfword, upper is unaffected.

enumeratedValue.name: REPLACE_2
enumeratedValue.description: Breakpoint on upper halfword, lower is unaffected.

enumeratedValue.name: REPLACE_3
enumeratedValue.description: Breakpoint on both lower and upper halfwords.

field.name: ENABLE
field.description: Enable bit for this comparator. A Power-on reset clears this bit to 0.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE_0
enumeratedValue.description: Comparator disabled.

enumeratedValue.name: ENABLE_1
enumeratedValue.description: Comparator enabled.

field.name: INTID
field.description: Interrupt ID of the interrupt to trigger, in the range 0-479.

register.name: AIRCR
register.description: Application Interrupt and Reset Control Register

field.name: VECTCLRACTIVE
field.description: Reserved for Debug use. This bit reads as 0. When writing to the register you must write 0 to this bit, otherwise behavior is UNPREDICTABLE. This bit is not banked between Security states.

field.name: SYSRESETREQ
field.description: System reset request. This bit allows software or a debugger to request a system reset. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW if SYSRESETREQS is 0. When SYSRESETREQS is set to 1, from Non-secure state this bit acts as RAZ/WI.

enumeratedValue.name: NO_REQUEST
enumeratedValue.description: Do not request a system reset.

enumeratedValue.name: REQUEST_RESET
enumeratedValue.description: Request a system reset.

field.name: SYSRESETREQS
field.description: System reset request, Secure state only. The value of this bit defines whether the SYSRESETREQ bit is functional for Non-secure use. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW from Secure State and RAZ/WI from Non-secure state.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURE_AND_NON_SECURE
enumeratedValue.description: SYSRESETREQ functionality is available to both Security states.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURE_ONLY
enumeratedValue.description: SYSRESETREQ functionality is only available to Secure state.

field.name: PRIGROUP
field.description: Interrupt priority grouping field. This field determines the split of group priority from subpriority. This bit is banked between Security states

field.name: BFHFNMINS
field.description: BusFault, HardFault, and NMI Non-secure enable. The value of this bit defines whether BusFault and NMI exceptions are Non-secure, and whether exceptions target the Non-secure HardFault exception. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW from Secure-state and RO from Non-secure state.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURE
enumeratedValue.description: BusFault, HardFault, and NMI are Secure.

enumeratedValue.name: NON_SECURE
enumeratedValue.description: BusFault and NMI are Non-secure and exceptions can target Non-secure HardFault.

field.name: PRIS
field.description: Prioritize Secure exceptions. The value of this bit defines whether Secure exception priority boosting is enabled. This bit is not banked between Security states. RW from Secure state and RAZ/WI from Non-secure state.

enumeratedValue.name: SAME_PRIORITY
enumeratedValue.description: Priority ranges of Secure and Non-secure exceptions are identical

enumeratedValue.name: SECURE_PRIORITIZED
enumeratedValue.description: Non-secure exceptions are de-prioritized

field.name: ENDIANNESS
field.description: Data endianness bit. This bit is not banked between Security states.

enumeratedValue.name: LITTLE_ENDIAN
enumeratedValue.description: Little-endian.

enumeratedValue.name: BIG_ENDIAN
enumeratedValue.description: Big-endian

field.name: VECTKEY
field.description: Register key: Reads as 0xFA05. On writes, write 0x5FA to VECTKEY, otherwise the write is ignored. This Field is not banked between Security states.

register.name: SCR
register.description: The SCR controls features of entry to and exit from low-power state.

field.name: SLEEPONEXIT
field.description: Indicates sleep-on-exit when returning from Handler mode to Thread mode. Setting this bit to 1 enables an interrupt driven application to avoid returning to an empty main application. This bit is banked between Security states.

enumeratedValue.name: NOT_SLEEP
enumeratedValue.description: Do not sleep when returning to Thread mode.

enumeratedValue.name: SLEEP
enumeratedValue.description: Enter sleep, or deep sleep, on return from an ISR

field.name: SLEEPDEEP
field.description: Controls whether the processor uses sleep or deep sleep as its low-power mode. This bit is not banked between Security states.

enumeratedValue.name: SLEEP
enumeratedValue.description: Sleep.

enumeratedValue.name: DEEP_SLEEP
enumeratedValue.description: Deep sleep.

field.name: SLEEPDEEPS
field.description: Controls whether the SLEEPDEEP bit is only accessible from the Secure state. This bit in only accessible from the Secure state, and behaves as RAZ/WI when accessed from the Nonsecure state. This bit is not banked between Security states.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURE_AND_NON_SECURE
enumeratedValue.description: The SLEEPDEEP bit is accessible from both Security states.

enumeratedValue.name: SECURE_ONLY
enumeratedValue.description: The SLEEPDEEP bit behaves as RAZ/WI when accessed from the Non-secure state.

field.name: SEVONPEND
field.description: Send Event on Pending bit. When an event or interrupt enters pending state, the event signal wakes up the processor from WFE. If the processor is not waiting for an event, the event is registered and affects the next WFE. The processor also wakes up on execution of an SEV instruction or an external event. This bit is banked between Security states.

enumeratedValue.name: EXCLUDE_DISABLED_INTERRUPTS
enumeratedValue.description: Only enabled interrupts or events can wakeup the processor, disabled interrupts are excluded.

enumeratedValue.name: INCLUDE_DISABLED_INTERRUPTS
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled events and all interrupts, including disabled interrupts, can wakeup the processor

register.name: DHCSR_Read
register.description: Debug Halting Control and Status Register

field.name: C_DEBUGEN
field.description: Halting debug enable bit. If a debugger writes to DHCSR to change the value of this bit from 0 to 1, it must also write 0 to the C_MASKINTS bit, otherwise behavior is UNPREDICTABLE. This bit can only be set to 1 from the DAP, it cannot be set to 1 under software control. This bit is 0 after a Power-on reset.

enumeratedValue.name: C_DEBUGEN_0
enumeratedValue.description: Disabled

enumeratedValue.name: C_DEBUGEN_1
enumeratedValue.description: Enabled

field.name: C_HALT
field.description: Processor halt bit. This bit is UNKNOWN after a Power-on reset.

enumeratedValue.name: C_HALT_0
enumeratedValue.description: No effect.

enumeratedValue.name: C_HALT_1
enumeratedValue.description: Halt the processor.

field.name: C_STEP
field.description: Processor step bit. This bit is UNKNOWN after a Power-on reset.

enumeratedValue.name: C_STEP_0
enumeratedValue.description: No effect.

enumeratedValue.name: C_STEP_1
enumeratedValue.description: Step the processor.

field.name: C_MASKINTS
field.description: C_MASKINTS bit. When debug is enabled, the debugger can write to this bit to mask PendSV, SysTick and external configurable interrupts. The effect of any attempt to change the value of this bit is UNPREDICTABLE unless both: - before the write to DHCSR, the value of the C_HALT bit is 1. - the write to the DHCSR that changes the C_MASKINTS bit also writes 1 to the C_HALT bit. This means that a single write to DHCSR cannot set the C_HALT to 0 and change the value of the C_MASKINTS bit. The bit does not affect NMI. When DHCSR.C_DEBUGEN is set to 0, the value of this bit is UNKNOWN. This bit is UNKNOWN after a Power-on reset.

enumeratedValue.name: C_MASKINTS_0
enumeratedValue.description: Do not mask.

enumeratedValue.name: C_MASKINTS_1
enumeratedValue.description: Mask PenSV, SysTick and external configurable interrupts.

field.name: S_REGRDY
field.description: S_REGRDY bit. A handshake flag for transfers through the DCRDR: - Writing to DCRSR clears the bit to 0. - Completion of the DCRDR transfer then sets the bit to 1. This bit is valid only when the processor is in Debug state, otherwise the bit is UNKNOWN.

enumeratedValue.name: S_REGRDY_0
enumeratedValue.description: There has been a write to the DCRDR, but the transfer is not complete.

enumeratedValue.name: S_REGRDY_1
enumeratedValue.description: The transfer to or from the DCRDR is complete.

field.name: S_HALT
field.description: S_HALT bit. Indicates whether the processor is in Debug state.

enumeratedValue.name: S_HALT_0
enumeratedValue.description: Not in Debug state.

enumeratedValue.name: S_HALT_1
enumeratedValue.description: In Debug state.

field.name: S_SLEEP
field.description: S_SLEEP bit. Indicates whether the processor is sleeping. The debugger must set the C_HALT bit to 1 to gain control, or wait for an interrupt or other wakeup event to wakeup the system.

enumeratedValue.name: S_SLEEP_0
enumeratedValue.description: Not sleeping.

enumeratedValue.name: S_SLEEP_1
enumeratedValue.description: Sleeping.

field.name: S_LOCKUP
field.description: S_LOCKUP bit. Indicates whether the processor is locked up because of an unrecoverable exception. This bit can only be read as 1 by a remote debugger, using the DAP. The value of 1 indicates that the processor is running but locked up. The bit clears to 0 when the processor enters Debug state.

enumeratedValue.name: S_LOCKUP_0
enumeratedValue.description: Not locked up

enumeratedValue.name: S_LOCKUP_1
enumeratedValue.description: Locked up

field.name: S_RETIRE_ST
field.description: S_RETIRE_ST bit. Indicates whether the processor has completed the execution of an instruction since the last read of DHCSR. This is a sticky bit, that clears to 0 on a read of DHCSR. A debugger can check this bit to determine if the processor is stalled on a load, store or fetch access. This bit is UNKNOWN after a Power-on or Local reset, but then is set to 1 as soon as the processor executes and retires an instruction.

enumeratedValue.name: S_RETIRE_ST_0
enumeratedValue.description: No instruction retired since last DHCSR read.

enumeratedValue.name: S_RETIRE_ST_1
enumeratedValue.description: At least one instruction retired since last DHCSR read.

field.name: S_RESET_ST
field.description: S_RESET_ST bit. Indicates whether the processor has been reset since the last read of DHCSR. This is a sticky bit, that clears to 0 on a read of DHCSR.

enumeratedValue.name: S_RESET_ST_0
enumeratedValue.description: No reset since last DHCSR read.

enumeratedValue.name: S_RESET_ST_1
enumeratedValue.description: At least one reset since last DHCSR read.

field.description: DBGTMP bits. Data temporary cache, for reading and writing the ARM core registers, special-purpose registers, and Floating-point extension registers. The value of this register is UNKNOWN: - on reset - if the processor is in Debug state, the debugger has written to DCRSR since entering Debug state and DHCSR.S_REGRDY is set to 0.
